ballistics_tracker_77da1560.name: Ballistics Tracker
ballistics_tracker_77da1560.info:
A StyLiS-branded phone mount. It's duct-taped to the side of your weapon. Somehow the phone can calculate the perfect position for a headshot.
Unbalances the weapon. Tracks targets within a small radius while aiming. Only you can see the targeting dots.

Unfortunately, the always-on targeting system makes it harder to conceal your own presence: your minimap hide range with suppressors is increased (worsened) by 30 studs, and your minimap pings last 30% longer.

flash_hider_8d4da284.name: Flash Hider
flash_hider_8d4da284.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

5% worse handling

dcl_120_114cfb13.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_114cfb13.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

410_flechette_d238ccf0.name: .410 Flechette
410_flechette_d238ccf0.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 flechettes, six small dart projectiles specially designed to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover.

410_bore_2141b724.name: .410 Bore
410_bore_2141b724.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 buckshot, four average sized pellets that are great for putting down pesky human-sized vermin.
Functions almost identically to the Judge default ammo.

410_birdshot_4657696b.name: .410 Birdshot
410_birdshot_4657696b.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration. Wider pellet spread due to wider choke.

410_slugs_9209d505.name: .410 Slugs
410_slugs_9209d505.info:
Changes your shot load to a .410 slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

410_rubber_pellets_3d15ee8a.name: .410 Rubber Pellets
410_rubber_pellets_3d15ee8a.info:
Changes your load to .410 rubber pellets, three rubber balls projectiles specially designed to make a target feel stinging pain.
Great for close range encounters but hardly make a difference at long range.

groza_5_45_conversion_c052720c.name: Groza 5.45 Conversion
groza_5_45_conversion_c052720c.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.45x39mm. It was never adopted simply because it was redundant compared to 7.62x39mm performance out of a shorter barrel. Average range performance and comes with a 45rd magazine!

groza_5_56_conversion_26fad4d8.name: Groza 5.56 Conversion
groza_5_56_conversion_26fad4d8.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.56x45mm NATO. It never went into production due to project funding issues. Improves weapon accuracy drastically but reduces overall damage and range.

snail_minifix_ab09ed92.info:

marble_jar_7752624c.name: Marble Jar
marble_jar_7752624c.info:

Now, eat the forbidden caviar...just don't lose your marbles while doing it, will ya?

tennis_balls_b009452e.name: Tennis Balls
tennis_balls_b009452e.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with two tennis balls! Start a ralley and launch two tennis balls which will deal more damage in range! Accounting for how light tennis balls are there may be deviation into if they will hit anyone.

vikhr_suppressor_ced3b7ab.name: Vikhr Suppressor
vikhr_suppressor_ced3b7ab.info:
A Zarovian suppressor akin to the one used on the AS VAL.
This suppressor behaves as a longer barrel giving your gun less recoil and preserving damage, slightly increased ranges with slower mobility, handling and reload speed as a tradeoff.

folded_grip_dda6a3fc.name: Folded Grip
folded_grip_dda6a3fc.info:
Fold up the integral grip of your weapon.
Provides small aimspeed and walkspeed benefits with poorer hipfire.

folded_grip_935bb201.name: Folded Grip
folded_grip_935bb201.info:
Fold up the integral grip of your weapon.
Provides small aimspeed and walkspeed benefits with poorer hipfire.

scar_trs_stock_85dada21.name: SCAR TRS Stock
scar_trs_stock_85dada21.info:
A special TPR stock for the SOCOM rifle family.
Sturdy stock perfect for combat in trying times.
Improves kick damper, kick speed, and general recoil. Reduces aim speed, maneuverability, and hipfire stability.

scar_trs_stock_70526460.name: SCAR TRS Stock
scar_trs_stock_70526460.info:

scar_sc_integral_c433658e.name: SCAR SC Integral
scar_sc_integral_c433658e.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the .300 BLK MK16 SOCOM SC and intended for police usage.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walkspeed and handling!

scar_sc_300_subsonic_d069a361.name: SCAR SC 300 Subsonic
scar_sc_300_subsonic_d069a361.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor and better ranged and headshot damage at the cost of low bullet speed and range!

scar_sc_9mm_conversion_234e4c16.name: SCAR SC 9mm Conversion
scar_sc_9mm_conversion_234e4c16.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM SC to fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit.
Uses a 50rd drum magazine.
Focusses on CQC by increasing the fire rate, close range damage and reducing the recoil but at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and penetration!

scar_sc_5_56_20eade92.name: SCAR SC 5.56
scar_sc_5_56_20eade92.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM SC to fire 5.56x45mm NATO!
Lower close up damage, but better ranged damage, bullet speed, hipfire control and much lower recoil!

integral_ak9_4765408a.name: Integral AK9
integral_ak9_4765408a.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the AK-9 platform.

Improves performance at close range at the cost of ranged performance and velocity. Excellent masking.

ak12_9x39_conversion_ec126a60.name: AK12 9x39 Conversion
ak12_9x39_conversion_ec126a60.info:
Converts your AK-9 to fire the more traditional 7.62x39mm cartridge, turning it into the AK-12 7.62mm prototype carbine.
Increases muzzle velocity and magazine capacity, while overall reducing damage and penetration slightly.

k1a_7_62x39_conversion_b7c7fbb5.name: K1A 7.62x39 Conversion
k1a_7_62x39_conversion_b7c7fbb5.info:
Loads your K1A with 7.62x39mm.
Compared to the DR-300, this is a modification to your K1A which through some clever machining, makes it the MAX-III, allowing it to feed the same 7.62x39 magazines coming with the same flaws as the DR-300 in its design.

38_special_df230004.name: .38 Special
38_special_df230004.info:
Specialty ammo made for the .357 caliber with the intent of more controllable power.
Less recoil results in greater accuracy, however poorer ranges in exchange for retaining damage.

ak107_bars_barrel_89b4ddf8.name: AK107 BARS Barrel
ak107_bars_barrel_89b4ddf8.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats.

long_barrel_ak105_70bb1851.name: Long Barrel (AK105)
long_barrel_ak105_70bb1851.info: Lengthens your barrel to match the one of the AK74M assault rifle! Increases fire rate and favors long range performance over close range by improving muzzle velocity and minimum damage but worsening close up damage!

105_5_56_conversion_755d9ab7.name: 105 5.56 Conversion
105_5_56_conversion_755d9ab7.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AK105 into 5.56x45mm NATO using a slightly modified 35-round magazine.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

pkp_duplex_e615ff81.name: PKP Duplex
pkp_duplex_e615ff81.info:
Loads your PKP with deadly 7.62x54mmR Duplex rounds.
Fires two bullets that deal significantly higher damage if both hit the same target.
Reduced fire rate due to the lower powder load.
Reduced penetration, suppression and may deviate from the center.

pkp_duplex_2a2a6b14.name: PKP Duplex
pkp_duplex_2a2a6b14.info:

mts_570_conversion_ba78f315.info:
A conversion for the MTS-569.
Trades off the stopping power of 12.7x55mm for the slightly better ballistics of 9x39mm SP, along with less recoil!
Changes the gun's name to the MTS-570!

rsh_12_gauge_75527aa6.name: RSH 12 Gauge
rsh_12_gauge_75527aa6.info: Loads your revolver in 28 Gauge shells effectively turning it into a full on shotgun revolver!

rsh_12_gauge_9dee45f0.name: RSH 12 Gauge
rsh_12_gauge_9dee45f0.info: Loads your revolver in 28 Gauge shells effectively turning it into a full on shotgun revolver!

1858c_short_barrel_67707ff9.name: 1858C Short Barrel
1858c_short_barrel_67707ff9.info: Shorter length barrel for the 1858 Carbine. Better Handling and movement, but the performance and damage suffers.

muzzle_booster_alt_727fd761.name: Muzzle Booster (Alt)
muzzle_booster_alt_727fd761.info: Makes the recoil higher in general.

muzzle_booster_alt_aaa58ca3.name: Muzzle Booster (Alt)
muzzle_booster_alt_aaa58ca3.info: Makes the recoil higher in general.

1858c_long_barrel_d2f23c8f.name: 1858C Long Barrel
1858c_long_barrel_d2f23c8f.info: Long barrel designed specifically for the 1858 line of revolvers. Increases range and bullet velocity but with worse handling.

36_caliber_c_2c1f51d4.name: .36 Caliber C
36_caliber_c_2c1f51d4.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

1858c_snake_shot_5d94448e.name: 1858C Snake Shot
1858c_snake_shot_5d94448e.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 44 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.

sa58_10rd_magazine_b60b387f.name: SA58 10rd Magazine
sa58_10rd_magazine_b60b387f.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

sa58_20rd_magazine_c51055c0.name: SA58 20rd Magazine
sa58_20rd_magazine_c51055c0.info: A smaller 20rd magazine for the SA58 OSW, acts like a typical battle rifle now but should be on the lighter side compared to the FAL 50.00!

fn_4x_scope_163649f6.name: FN 4x Scope
fn_4x_scope_163649f6.info:
A simple in-house manufactured optic made especially for the FAL rifles along the custom dust cover to mount the scope, provides a clear sight image being simple to read although isn't meant for really long ranges.

Model by Rialag

sa80_22_lr_18dfc62c.name: SA80 .22 LR
sa80_22_lr_18dfc62c.info: Somehow, a great evil has returned. An esoteric conversion for the SA80 weapons. It trades away damage in exchange for much more manageable recoil and extra handling speed. Aim for headshots and it will be like you have unlimited power.

luty_rifled_barrel_c59b1165.name: LUTY Rifled Barrel
luty_rifled_barrel_c59b1165.info:
Adds rifling to your barrel which entirely eliminates the issue of tumbling bullets.
Cannot be used with muzzle or suppressor attachments.

luty_integral_suppressor_efc7ae68.name: LUTY Integral Suppressor
luty_integral_suppressor_efc7ae68.info:
150 stud detection radius.

Barely makes your gun quieter but mildly improves weapon sway for slightly slower handling!

drum_magazine_d74328b0.name: Drum Magazine
drum_magazine_d74328b0.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold many more rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

hb_trash_panda_19535fe8.info:

Making it by technicality, the M639 SMG. Easier to control recoil.

Why would you use this? Why would you want to use this?

ppsh_41_obrez_barrel_cf44e86a.info: Completely cut off most of your barrel to form a very homemade looking pistol. Expect close range performance to increase drastically but long range to suffer.

35rd_box_mag_af8661a1.name: 35rd Box Mag
35rd_box_mag_af8661a1.info: A Zarovian designated 35-round box magazine that originally came with the PPSH-41. Increases general mobility due to it's lighter weight, and recoil will be a bit easier to control.

hk_reduced_mag_9d079bca.name: HK Reduced Mag
hk_reduced_mag_9d079bca.info: A smaller magazine that only holds 10 rounds! But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun significantly!

oss_suppressor_310d70f5.name: OSS Suppressor
oss_suppressor_310d70f5.info:
35 stud detection radius.

Covert Ops suppressor built during WW2 to accommodate the M3 SMG, and adapted for use on the M3A1.
Improved performance at range with decent masking.

type_37_conversion_2e37cd9c.name: Type 37 Conversion
type_37_conversion_2e37cd9c.info:
Changes the internals of your M3A1 to match the one of its clone, the Type 37.
This clone developed by Jinhan fires 9x19mm. Offering a higher headshot multiplier, more accuracy, more spare ammo and better range performance!
However, your close range damage is reduced!

g36c_300_conversion_3b972587.name: G36C .300 Conversion
g36c_300_conversion_3b972587.info:
Load your STG-91C with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group. It offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

ia2_smg_reduced_mag_540ed968.name: IA2 SMG Reduced Mag
ia2_smg_reduced_mag_540ed968.info: A smaller magazine that only holds 17 rounds! But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun significantly!

ia2_smg_40_s_w_6fc9cf46.name: IA2 SMG 40 S&W
ia2_smg_40_s_w_6fc9cf46.info:
Converts your IA2 SMG to fire .40 S&W. Increased damage up close while also increasing penetration and suppression but worse ranged performance and slightly higher recoil!
Smaller magazine capacity but lowers overall gun weight.

five_0_full_auto_trigger_group_77c975a2.name: FIVE-0 Full-Auto Trigger Group
five_0_full_auto_trigger_group_77c975a2.info: Change the trigger group of your FIVE-0 to make it fire in full-automatic and semi-automatic. Lowers your firerate, ranges, and increases recoil somewhat.

five_0_45acp_conversion_2fdd3ccf.name: FIVE-0 45ACP Conversion
five_0_45acp_conversion_2fdd3ccf.info: Convert your FIVE-0 into firing .45 ACP, increasing magazine capacity at the cost of close up damage. Slight rate of fire increase.

five_0_9mm_conversion_58c02dfb.name: FIVE-0 9mm Conversion
five_0_9mm_conversion_58c02dfb.info: Convert your FIVE-0 into firing 9x19mm, greatly increases your magazine capacity at the cost of close range effectiveness. Also increases rate of fire.

mp5sd_burst_trigger_group_a55ee764.name: MP5SD Burst Trigger Group
mp5sd_burst_trigger_group_a55ee764.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9SD to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance at further distances with damage dropping off slower. Generally easier to control recoil.

mac10_stock_f0b6b62e.name: Mac10 Stock
mac10_stock_f0b6b62e.info: Extend the default stock out to reduce overall camera recoil with some minor handling and reload speed reductions.

mac10_stock_57b0dac4.name: Mac10 Stock
mac10_stock_57b0dac4.info: Extend the default stock out to reduce overall camera recoil with some minor handling and reload speed reductions.

sionics_suppressor_27fd5887.name: Sionics Suppressor
sionics_suppressor_27fd5887.info:
No detection radius.

A unique suppressor designed for the MAC-10, famous for being so quiet that the action can be heard cycling. A mixture of the long barrel and heavy suppressor. Great for close range combat, but can be decently useful at long range too.

sionics_suppressor_eda6cc22.name: Sionics Suppressor
sionics_suppressor_eda6cc22.info:
No detection radius.

m10_carbine_barrel_e2841543.name: M10 Carbine Barrel
m10_carbine_barrel_e2841543.info: A familiar looking barrel for the Carbine Variant of the MAC-10. Further positives but also negative aspects than the typical long barrel!

mac10_9mm_conversion_b55c7c4c.name: Mac10 9mm Conversion
mac10_9mm_conversion_b55c7c4c.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MAC-10 into 9x19mm!
Shoots significantly faster. Reduces recoil and improves bullet speed but weaker damage!

uzi_45_conversion_1c3f6915.name: Uzi .45 Conversion
uzi_45_conversion_1c3f6915.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .45 ACP.
Improve damage performance but makes the recoil harder to control. Lowered RPM.
Conversion kit by Vector Arms allows the UZI to use M3A1 magazines!

uzi_41_conversion_335d3d43.name: Uzi .41 Conversion
uzi_41_conversion_335d3d43.info:
Locks to Semi-Auto.
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .41 Action Express in a custom 20 round magazine. Perfect for seige missions.
Use this ammo to punch through cover, and land harder hits to take down the opposition.

uzi_22lr_conversion_bb04a097.name: Uzi .22LR Conversion
uzi_22lr_conversion_bb04a097.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .22 Long Rifle.
Stats similar to the ZIP22... But in full auto! Why would you do this?
Comes with a specially made 50 round Promag!

cmars_9x30_conversion_3fe486c5.name: CMARS 9x30 Conversion
cmars_9x30_conversion_3fe486c5.info:
Load your MARS with 9x30mm MARS, a cartridge made from a necked down 10mm Magnum round.

Possesses high stopping power up close, but falls off at longer ranges.

x95_armscor_ammo_29cbf370.name: X95 Armscor Ammo
x95_armscor_ammo_29cbf370.info: Specialty Armascor 9x19mm ammo stuffed with 3 tiny, buckshot-like, pellets. Splits the stats, and uses a smaller magazine than normal. More powerful than you'd expect, and reloads swiftly.

x95_5_56x30_conversion_bcfbeeb5.name: X95 5.56x30 Conversion
x95_5_56x30_conversion_bcfbeeb5.info: An experimental version of the X95 chambered in 5.56x30mm MINSAS for the Sindhara Army. It was ultimately cancelled, but that doesn't stop you! Reduces close range damage while massively boosting muzzle velocity and damage at range.

fal_50_reduced_magazine_2bea310c.name: FAL 50 Reduced Magazine
fal_50_reduced_magazine_2bea310c.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

fal_50_reduced_magazine_ec48ffd9.name: FAL 50 Reduced Magazine
fal_50_reduced_magazine_ec48ffd9.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

lmx_suppressor_6b0af01f.name: LMX Suppressor
lmx_suppressor_6b0af01f.info:
25 stud detection radius.

An unique suppressor designed for the X46A2!
Improves mid-range performance at the cost of some handling.

mp7_b2f_2aae13e8.name: MP7 B2F
mp7_b2f_2aae13e8.info:
A two-part fragmenting bullet designed for the X46, designed to improve damage against soft targets.
Minor spread and deals significantly higher damage if both bullets hit but lower bullet speed and penetration.

mp7_dm31_4d10163d.name: MP7 DM31
mp7_dm31_4d10163d.info:
An copped-plated steel armor-piercing round for the X46.
Provides excellent penetrative capabilities, but lacks overall damage.

mp7_5_7x28_dcd14578.name: MP7 5.7x28
mp7_5_7x28_dcd14578.info:
A 5.7x28mm conversion for the X46 based off of a civilian X46 clone.
Provides improved damage from the larger round at the cost of increased recoil and a limited magazine size.

kov_9mm_conversion_0d51b529.name: KOV 9mm Conversion
kov_9mm_conversion_0d51b529.info:
Load your Krinkov with 9x19mm.
 It uses a specialty magwell adapter so it can accept SMX-9 styled magazines.
Now it can be a 'true pdw' (even though it already was before)!

kov_7_62_conversion_e397155a.name: KOV 7.62 Conversion
kov_7_62_conversion_e397155a.info:
Load your Krinkov with 7.62x39mm.
 Expect the damage of your firearm to improve greatly with a little added range too. Controlling it might be a problem.

bwc9_fire_selector_burst_0aebd9a8.name: BWC9 Fire Selector Burst
bwc9_fire_selector_burst_0aebd9a8.info: Adds a fire selector to your BWC9. Capable of firing in 3 shot burst.

bwc9_fire_selector_semi_7d2062ff.name: BWC9 Fire Selector Semi
bwc9_fire_selector_semi_7d2062ff.info: Removes the fire selector making it the commercial BWC9.

bwc9_shortbarrel_3cb2b15c.name: BWC9 ShortBarrel
bwc9_shortbarrel_3cb2b15c.info: If you ever wanted an even 5 point range drop off and no way to add barrel attachments, you got it. Buffs overall mobility of the BWC9.

bwc9_17rnd_c38a9c6b.name: BWC9 17rnd
bwc9_17rnd_c38a9c6b.info:
A shorter magazine for the BWC9 with slightly improved handling characteristics and impressive reserve ammo.

How can I hold all of these magazines?

bwc9_30rnd_4096258f.name: BWC9 30rnd
bwc9_30rnd_4096258f.info: Increases your magsize to 30 from 21. 5% decrease to overall mobility.

mp5k_stock_11b09e5c.name: MP5K Stock
mp5k_stock_11b09e5c.info: Specially made stock for the SMX-9K. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

mp5k_burst_trigger_group_c1f44141.name: MP5K Burst Trigger Group
mp5k_burst_trigger_group_c1f44141.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9K to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage to torsos an damage overall giving more breathing room in range if you hit torso shots. Easier to control recoil.

mp5k_10mm_conversion_63f1f5a8.name: MP5K 10mm Conversion
mp5k_10mm_conversion_63f1f5a8.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your SMX-9K into 10mm Auto, effectively making it the ''SMX-9/10''.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired, can you handle the bull?.

vector_357_conversion_6b128652.name: Vector 357 Conversion
vector_357_conversion_6b128652.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into .357 SIG.
I hope you weren't expecting an easy ride with this conversion...

vector_9mm_conversion_8f5e87b6.name: Vector 9mm Conversion
vector_9mm_conversion_8f5e87b6.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into 9x19mm.
Bigger mag with slightly less recoil, but at the cost of damage, velocity, and a bit of range!.

vector_22lr_conversion_391a1e1d.name: Vector .22LR Conversion
vector_22lr_conversion_391a1e1d.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into .22 Long Rifle.
Kills overall performance, but is really nasty with headshots and aiming is a little faster.
Comes with a 20 round magazine. Reloading this thing will be a breeze!

bizon_7_62_conversion_6e025d17.name: BIZON 7.62 Conversion
bizon_7_62_conversion_6e025d17.info:
Loads your PP-19 BIZON with 7.62x25mm.
 Smaller magazine, but more power and more motherland!

bizon_9x18mm_conversion_56c0c6ab.name: BIZON 9x18mm Conversion
bizon_9x18mm_conversion_56c0c6ab.info:
Loads your PP-19 BIZON with 9x18mm Makarov.
 Larger magazine and less recoil, but slower and less damaging bullets. Not optimal for ranged encounters.

trench_sweeper_a697f2d5.name: Trench Sweeper
trench_sweeper_a697f2d5.info: Change your internals of your Typewriter with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun. Insanely high fire rate and improves your handling significantly but comes at the cost of a limited 30 round magazine and wild recoil!

box_grip_14dfbd26.name: Box Grip
box_grip_14dfbd26.info: Install the original M1A1 box grip back onto the Tommy gun. Minor stat changes.

box_grip_e1575a67.name: Box Grip
box_grip_e1575a67.info: Install the original M1A1 box grip back onto the Tommy gun. Minor stat changes.

fbi_10_tommy_34f2bf7d.name: FBI 10 TOMMY
fbi_10_tommy_34f2bf7d.info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the specialized FBI variant that fired 10mm Auto.
Turn the criminal's own weapon against them, with rounds kick like a mule!

lyman_sight_84e7980f.name: Lyman Sight
lyman_sight_84e7980f.info:
Flip up the Thompson's rear sight.
The Lyman sight was created specifically for the Thompson. It is primarily found on Soveran models of the weapon and exists on most Thompsons.

p_a_w_s_45_conversion_9a27da80.name: P.A.W.S. 45 Conversion
p_a_w_s_45_conversion_9a27da80.info:
Load your L2A3 with .45 ACP.
This is less a Sterling L2A3, and more of its own thing. The Police Automatic Weapons System ZX-7 was the result of a wish to import the Soveran L2A3 into the Grand Federation. More power in close range with more felt recoil.

p90_civvy_mag_54c97810.name: P90 Civvy Mag
p90_civvy_mag_54c97810.info:
Despite looking like a typical P90 magazine this one can only hold thirty rounds and was made for the civilian market.
Less rounds in a magazine (obviously), but slightly better mobility and reload speed.

mp5_burst_trigger_group_cf65fd25.name: MP5 Burst Trigger Group
mp5_burst_trigger_group_cf65fd25.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance in close range but damage drops off faster. Easier to control recoil.

30rd_mag_29c9b492.name: 30rd Mag
30rd_mag_29c9b492.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 30 rounds. Reduced total spare rounds carried, slower reload and walkspeed.

m1919_conversion_8cec6cf7.name: M1919 Conversion
m1919_conversion_8cec6cf7.info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun.
Expect your firerate to go up, but your handling to drop extensively...

50rd_drum_0574e54b.name: 50rd Drum
50rd_drum_0574e54b.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold a whopping 50 rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

aug_40_s_w_conversion_718b814e.name: AUG 40 S&W Conversion
aug_40_s_w_conversion_718b814e.info:
Converts your UAR A3 PARA into the AUG 40 firing the .40 S&W cartridge.
Lower fire rate while increasing CQC damage, range and penetration but has a weaker ranged damage and bullet speed.

380_rama_4061cdd5.name: 380 RAMA
380_rama_4061cdd5.info: Switch the ammotype used in your RAMA 1130 into 380 ACP. Stats adjusted to suit the ammo type fired.

mp_9_remove_limiter_8568c401.name: MP-9 Remove Limiter
mp_9_remove_limiter_8568c401.info:
Removes the fire rate limiter from your MP-9 allowing it to fire at the full 1500 RPM!
Results in less accuracy and is not compatible with the drum magazine.

tec_9_long_barrel_6ab93576.name: Tec-9 Long Barrel
tec_9_long_barrel_6ab93576.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

tec_9_long_barrel_c4d768c5.name: Tec-9 Long Barrel
tec_9_long_barrel_c4d768c5.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

tec_9_short_barrel_e4e99517.name: Tec-9 Short Barrel
tec_9_short_barrel_e4e99517.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

tec_9_short_barrel_b587d482.name: Tec-9 Short Barrel
tec_9_short_barrel_b587d482.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

remove_grip_7f05c53b.name: Remove Grip
remove_grip_7f05c53b.info:
Removes the grip from your MP-9!
Improves handling for increased recoil!

20_round_mp_9_3a38e0e3.name: 20 Round MP-9
20_round_mp_9_3a38e0e3.info: A 20 round capacity magazine used on the TEC-9. Improves handling and reload speeds..

mp_9_drum_245610d0.name: MP-9 Drum
mp_9_drum_245610d0.info: A large 9mm drum magazine. Massively improves magazine capacity at a significant gun handling penalty.

10_round_mp_9_75b65bea.name: 10 Round MP-9
10_round_mp_9_75b65bea.info: A 10 round magazine for your extremely high RPM PDW. Only use if you know what you're doing.

mp5_10_burst_trigger_group_e5b71a1c.name: MP5/10 Burst Trigger Group
mp5_10_burst_trigger_group_e5b71a1c.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9/10 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance in close range but damage drops off faster with poorer damage in range. Easier to control recoil.

mp5_40_conversion_a503e431.name: MP5 .40 Conversion
mp5_40_conversion_a503e431.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your SMX-9/10 into .40 Smith & Wesson.
Less recoil for better accuracy for decreased close range damage and bullet speed, long range damage is preserved.

k7_5_56x45_conversion_176c7f6b.name: K7 5.56x45 Conversion
k7_5_56x45_conversion_176c7f6b.info:
Load your K7 with 5.56x45mm NATO.
With some expert gunsmithing you managed to successfully change the round of which your K7 fires to be of the more common 5.56x45mm NATO. Giving performance which fits more a carbine, but is louder due to the nature of this cartridge not being subsonic.

scar_pdw_9mm_conversion_6aca68cb.name: SCAR PDW 9mm Conversion
scar_pdw_9mm_conversion_6aca68cb.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM CQB into a true PDW by letting it fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit by Big Woods MFG.
Higher fire rate, close up damage and lower recoil, but lowers ranged damage, penetration and bullet speed.
Retains light weight and quick reload speed!

scar_pdw_7_62_conversion_d7b54112.name: SCAR PDW 7.62 Conversion
scar_pdw_7_62_conversion_d7b54112.info:
Swaps your MK16 SOCOM CQB receiver for the one of the MK17 SOCOM, effectively making it a MK17 PDW!

Very high damage - especially in close range - but suffers somewhat from the reduced magazine capacity of 10 and relatively unstable recoil.

ump_9_conversion_b0f98d9c.name: UMP 9 Conversion
ump_9_conversion_b0f98d9c.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-9.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

ump_40_conversion_fee42d8b.name: UMP .40 Conversion
ump_40_conversion_fee42d8b.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-40.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

msg90_308_conversion_620bd080.name: MSG90 308 Conversion
msg90_308_conversion_620bd080.info:
Load your JG-90 with .308 Winchester.
Giving a familiar 10 round magazine, Your JG-90 now has the benefits of the .308 cartridge which include faster velocities and the ability to kill to the head. Alongside being a whole lot lighter.

suppressor_0b40a363.name: Suppressor..?
suppressor_0b40a363.info:
Wait, what are you doing? Stop, this literally doesn't give you any benefit. Why are you like this?
(It does nothing but pitch up your fire sound. Do not buy).

vss_762_conv_77bd2b76.info:
Changes the ammotype fired from your VSS VINTOREZ to 7.62x39mm.
This retools your weapon to be a lot like the civilian model produced by Molot Arms, that suppressor is not doing anything, bucko.

short_barrel_dmr_78e3ed0d.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

vpo_366_slugs_0cf5f1b7.name: VPO .366 (Slugs)
vpo_366_slugs_0cf5f1b7.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

vpo_366_buckshot_2bc183a5.name: VPO .366 (Buckshot)
vpo_366_buckshot_2bc183a5.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM (Buckshot).
By Zarovian law this makes your gun a shotgun because of the smoothbore barrel.

saiga_545_conversion_0ab56ddc.name: Saiga 545 Conversion
saiga_545_conversion_0ab56ddc.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.45x39mm with a 45 round magazine!
Lowers recoil, increases fire rate, magazine capacity and bullet speed while keeping a good range performance but comes at a cost of close range damage, penetration and some handling!

saiga_762_conversion_ba754876.name: Saiga 762 Conversion
saiga_762_conversion_ba754876.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 7.62x39mm with a 30rd magazine!
Keeps damage high especially to the torso while also increasing your fire rate, but lowers overall damage and penetration!

saiga_223_conversion_326ae997.name: Saiga 223 Conversion
saiga_223_conversion_326ae997.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in .223 Rem. with a 40 round magazine!
Uses some ''legal'' modifications to the receiver to turn your SAR fully automatic. Treat this as an assault rifle with an extended magazine!

saiga_220_russian_conversion_82efdbfb.name: Saiga 220 Russian Conversion
saiga_220_russian_conversion_82efdbfb.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.6x39mm, a 5.6mm projectile from necked down 7.62x39mm brass!
Excellent bullet speed with improved damage falloff, very lethal headshot damage and more penetration than 7.62x39mm but lowers your close range performance!

5_56x45_shellshock_mk12_3d1dd3ac.name: 5.56x45 Shellshock (MK12)
5_56x45_shellshock_mk12_3d1dd3ac.info: An extremely high-pressure 5.56x45mm cartridge made from a nickel alloy, designed to provide nearly 30% additional velocity to the cartridge and improve long-range ballistics. Slightly higher recoil, but better headshot performance.

svk12e_7_62_conversion_aff176e2.name: SVK12E 7.62 Conversion
svk12e_7_62_conversion_aff176e2.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for 7.62x51mm NATO, intended for the export market. The SVK-12E foregos the trigger group of the 7.62x54mmR variant for a unique 2-round burst only trigger designed to improve shot accuracy at mid-range through volume of fire. It is dubiously effective.

Somewhat reduced damage, but overall improved recoil control..

svk12e_12_7_conversion_ab61a9e4.name: SVK12E 12.7 Conversion
svk12e_12_7_conversion_ab61a9e4.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for the relatively uncommon 12.7x55mm ammo type, typically used by special forces and police units for higher stopping power. Like many of the other AK-12 prototype variants, no real credible info exists on the development of this rifle in this chambering.

Very high damage with somewhat low muzzle velocity..

g28_308_conversion_5cdb596b.name: G28 308 Conversion
g28_308_conversion_5cdb596b.info: Load your M28 with .308 Winchester, turning it into the civilian M28Z model. Uses a lower-capacity magazine but packs a stronger punch while improving overall handling somewhat.

pm_ii_ultrashort_81230199.name: PM II Ultrashort
pm_ii_ultrashort_81230199.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

dbp88_2cd878fc.info:
A variant of 5.8x42mm designed specifically for squad automatic weapons and designated marksman rifles.

Utilizes a heavy steel core extending your range and penetration at the cost of close range performance, camera recoil control and bullet speed!

cs_os15_124fa862.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_124fa862.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

22_rat_shot_ruger_ff74f994.info:
Loads your gun with small .22 Rat Shot bullets, each firing 10 pellets with little spread!
Powerful up close, especially to the head but has very poor muzzle velocity, penetration and ranged performance!

22_super_colibri_80cfac48.name: .22 Super Colibri
22_super_colibri_80cfac48.info: Loads your .22LR rifle with Super Colibri rounds, which are the closest you'll get to a pellet gun with how pathetic the velocity is.

ssr_6_5_conversion_a623d1ef.name: SSR 6.5 Conversion
ssr_6_5_conversion_a623d1ef.info:
Transforms your gun into the ''MK20S'' firing 6.5mm Creedmoor!
Slightly shorter round that has better velocity, lower recoil and the ability to one shot head at all ranges!
Significantly worse anywhere outside the head and reduced penetration!

tcr_duplex_binary_228fa184.name: TCR Duplex Binary
tcr_duplex_binary_228fa184.info: A binary-trigger group allows you to fire your gun on a trigger pull and to fire again once you let go. Duplex rounds not included.

beowulf_458_conversion_0cd9d91a.name: Beowulf .458 Conversion
beowulf_458_conversion_0cd9d91a.info:
Loads your Neowulf TCR rifle with .458 SOCOM.

Lowers recoil and increases velocity at the cost of performance, but also doubles your magazine capacity.

tcr_5_56_conversion_bda3c8db.name: TCR 5.56 Conversion
tcr_5_56_conversion_bda3c8db.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Perfect for getting that civilian firearm feeling!

aug_dmr_burst_group_363c787b.name: AUG DMR Burst Group
aug_dmr_burst_group_363c787b.info: Adds a 3-round burst trigger group to the UAR A3M2 for a unique trigger control flavor.

a3m2_300_subsonic_982c30e3.name: A3M2 300 Subsonic
a3m2_300_subsonic_982c30e3.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor while offering improved damage performance at long ranges at the cost of poor muzzle velocity and reduced penetration!

a3m2_223_bthp_63825259.name: A3M2 223 BTHP
a3m2_223_bthp_63825259.info:
Chambers your UAR A3M2 in .223 Rem BTHP, a hollow point cartridge used for high-precision sport shooting.
Comes with a 10-round magazine offering more mobility, handling and a faster reload while having great damage towards headshots but body damage becomes poor at range.

depleted_uranium_188ee39b.name: Depleted Uranium
depleted_uranium_188ee39b.info:
Changes your ammunition to rounds with a depleted uranium core.
Aside from the usual rounds created for 20mm or 30mm guns, small amounts of it were made in .308 Winchester. For some strange reason depleted uranium has the quality of self sharpening when in contact with something. Very high bullet velocity and more penetration than you know what to do with.
Physically cannot work with suppressors.

depleted_uranium_cc7846bc.name: Depleted Uranium
depleted_uranium_cc7846bc.info:
Changes your ammunition to rounds with a depleted uranium core.
Aside from the usual rounds created for 20mm or 30mm guns, small amounts of it were made in .308 Winchester. For some strange reason depleted uranium has the quality of self sharpening when in contact with something. Very high bullet velocity and more penetration than you know what to do with.
Physically cannot work with suppressors.

mk11_500_conversion_f060b3e3.name: MK11 500 Conversion
mk11_500_conversion_f060b3e3.info:
Convert your MK11 to fire .500 Phantom. Made specifically for the AR10 platform.
Very slow bullet, increased recoil, but with a dramatic power increase.

svu_a_conversion_kit_779e811e.name: SVU-A Conversion Kit
svu_a_conversion_kit_779e811e.info: Change the internals of your SVU sniper rifle into that of the SVU-A with an extended magazine. Treat it as a hard to control battle rifle (especially in auto which should only be used for emergencies)...

svu_953_conversion_1a4f5a0e.name: SVU 953 Conversion
svu_953_conversion_1a4f5a0e.info:
Load your SVU with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A much large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

pso_12_7_5cf0bafe.name: PSO-12.7
pso_12_7_5cf0bafe.info:

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

sl8_binary_48f44263.name: SL8 Binary
sl8_binary_48f44263.info:
Modify your VG-98 to fit it with a binary trigger group.
A binary trigger fires one round when you hold down the trigger, but also fires again when you let go!

sl_8_300_conversion_a2f75254.name: SL-8 .300 Conversion
sl_8_300_conversion_a2f75254.info:
Load your VG-98 with .300 Whisper.
 Effectively making it an VG-98S, a specially designed round made to fire at subsonic sound levels. It is a very big bullet that works very well with suppressors!

m21_6_5_2b038755.name: M21 6.5
m21_6_5_2b038755.info:
Loads your M21 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
Featuring a 20 round magazine, your M21 has its performance affected due 6.5mm. However, you suffer from weaker headshot damage and overall modifier reductions.

m198_duplex_1f82de80.name: M198 Duplex
m198_duplex_1f82de80.info:
Loads your rifle with 7.62x51mm M198 duplex ammunition. Designed to improve hit probability, the ammunition fires two smaller bullets with every pull of the trigger.

Unfortunately, the smaller bullets tumble at longer ranges negating any sort of advantage offered by the additional projectiles.

spr_308_conv_5a38b6e7.name: SPR .308 Conv
spr_308_conv_5a38b6e7.info:
Uses .308 Winchester, a stronger round with higher bullet speed, penetration, improved damage ranges and better head/torso damage!
Slight increase in camera recoil but also exclusively uses 10 round magazines, you will however get better walk speed, handling and a faster reload!

spr_drum_mag_fd5714c4.name: SPR Drum Mag
spr_drum_mag_fd5714c4.info: 50rd X-FAL drum magazine! Gives you a significant amount of ammo but reloads slow and will lower your walkspeed and handling!

spr_extended_mag_101698ae.name: SPR Extended Mag
spr_extended_mag_101698ae.info:
A 30 round magazine for your FAL! Allowing it to last longer in battle but your reload time will be even longer than it already is!
Lower walkspeed, reserve and handling!

improved_choke_e5545576.name: Improved Choke
improved_choke_e5545576.info:
Chokes are cylinders attached to the barrel to tighten the spread. This one is the least constrictive of the chokes, offering little gain but little drawback. Perfect for pursuitin' them upland birds!
Don't ask how it works with slugs, okay?

duckbill_choke_41c76dea.name: Duckbill Choke
duckbill_choke_41c76dea.info:
This choke just doesn't tighten spread, it does it horizontally.
Lower velocity, tighter vertical spread, more horizontal spread.

modified_choke_3073371f.name: Modified Choke
modified_choke_3073371f.info:
The middle ground of the chokes, offering more bang for your buck(shot)! Better benefits, but also worse losses. Perfect for huntin' some waterfouls.
Don't ask how it works with slugs, okay?

slugs_861ae749.name: Slugs
slugs_861ae749.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

slugs_f7dc6c92.name: Slugs
slugs_f7dc6c92.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

s_12_full_auto_conversion_2361dab1.name: S-12 Full-Auto Conversion
s_12_full_auto_conversion_2361dab1.info:
Change the internals of your Saiga-12 to make it able to fire in full automatic!
Extremely fast fire rate but hard to control!
Loses out on accuracy and damage range.

s_12_full_auto_conversion_d6444688.name: S-12 Full-Auto Conversion
s_12_full_auto_conversion_d6444688.info:
Change the internals of your Saiga-12 to make it able to fire in full automatic!
Extremely fast fire rate but hard to control!
Loses out on accuracy and damage range.

flechette_74fac098.name: Flechette
flechette_74fac098.info:
Changes your shot load to flechettes, small dart projectiles specially desgined to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover but less effective against limbs.

flechette_78170273.name: Flechette
flechette_78170273.info:

Great for enemies hiding behind cover but less effective against limbs.

rubber_pellets_abca3870.name: Rubber Pellets
rubber_pellets_abca3870.info: Shotgun shells loaded with rubber buckshot. Less than lethal isn't the same as non-lethal, and you're about to prove that...

rubber_pellets_ac33b99b.name: Rubber Pellets
rubber_pellets_ac33b99b.info: Shotgun shells loaded with rubber buckshot. Less than lethal isn't the same as non-lethal, and you're about to prove that...

s_12u_50_conversion_ad4653c6.name: S-12U 50 Conversion
s_12u_50_conversion_ad4653c6.info:
Load your Saiga-12U with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- ok, there is no way you're going to get anything working this way...

birdshot_078721e4.name: Birdshot
birdshot_078721e4.info:
Changes your shot load to birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration.

birdshot_225facf7.name: Birdshot
birdshot_225facf7.info:
Changes your shot load to birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration.

sass_358_conversion_b6ee12c0.name: SASS 358 Conversion
sass_358_conversion_b6ee12c0.info:
An alternate ammo type for the SASS 308.
 The .358 Winchester cartridge gives your SASS weapon more power close up towards an enemies torso, trading long range performance. A perfect panic backup.

full_choke_b2573cd0.name: Full Choke
full_choke_b2573cd0.info: The choke with the tighest constriction, offering the tightest spread of pellets. Great for long range precision shots, but beware of missing your shots up close.

muffler_alt_fa871f6d.name: Muffler (Alt)
muffler_alt_fa871f6d.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and in this case, will not affect firerate.

oil_filter_alt_45c396e6.name: Oil Filter (Alt)
oil_filter_alt_45c396e6.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

diverter_d74ad430.name: Diverter
diverter_d74ad430.info: The kind of choke that was made when someone looked at duckbill and didn't think it was enough. Further decreases your vertical spread but increases the horizontal spread even more than before!

paradox_choke_310973df.name: Paradox Choke
paradox_choke_310973df.info:
Otherwise known as a ''spreader''.
A strange but simple choke that is simply an extension to the barrel with rifling.
Unlike other choke this one works great with slugs!

minislugs_2d3ed316.name: Minislugs
minislugs_2d3ed316.info:
Changes your shot load to minislugs.
Short, stumpy 1¾ inch shotgun shells that aid in recoil control. Increases capacity if held in a tube by a few shells due to a shorter length. Not as high damage as full size slugs but travels a little faster with faster action and reloading.

traditional_pump_7b959b89.info: Swap your shorty's regular foregrip with a more traditional pump, decreases spread in exchange for a slower fire rate!

exotic_slugs_m79_5203b0e9.info:

buckshot_m79_bc8e9167.info:

sponge_m79_08114cbf.info:
Changes your shot load to a 40mm Sponge Grenade, a large projectile produced to disable or confuse a single target (for riot control).
Powerful and able to down an opponent instantly at any range but suffers from extremely low muzzle velocity!

410_beehive_m79_8c52ef06.name: 410 Beehive (M79)
410_beehive_m79_8c52ef06.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 bore housed in a four slotted hornet's nest shell (16 pellets).
Less power and ammo, but more range, speed, and pellets per shot.

e_shotgun_light_discs_315f8b05.name: e Shotgun Light Discs
e_shotgun_light_discs_315f8b05.info: Lightweight 'pancakes' that improve the bullet speed but decrease accuracy, supppresion, and increases spread.

e_shotgun_heavy_discs_2daf8fa6.name: e Shotgun Heavy Discs
e_shotgun_heavy_discs_2daf8fa6.info: Improves the spread with heavier 'pancakes', with stronger suppression. Range is more evenly spread. Bullets drop faster.

e_shotgun_penny_conversion_8a7a8b72.name: e Shotgun Penny Conversion
e_shotgun_penny_conversion_8a7a8b72.info: Instead of large discs you loaded the magazine with pennies. That's one way to spend your money... your reserve ammo now equates to about 3 dollars.

e_shotgun_hds_177e427a.info:
