And if that don't work: Use more gun.

thunder_squeezebore_cc9b3e27.name: Thunder Squeezebore
thunder_squeezebore_cc9b3e27.info: Swaps out your THUNDER's ammunition with squeezebore rounds, giving it multiple projectiles at the cost of accuracy and damage potential at range.

front_post_0d9d01ca.name: Front Post
front_post_0d9d01ca.info:
Attach a front post to your 3-line rifle.
Optional and free!

front_post_c5b484c6.name: Front Post
front_post_c5b484c6.info:
Attach a front post to your 3-line rifle.
Optional and free!

obrez_long_barrel_56d0c027.name: Obrez Long Barrel
obrez_long_barrel_56d0c027.info: Fit your Obrez with an extended barrel, improving muzzle velocity but affecting other areas of the weapons performance.

obrez_410_2b077f4e.name: OBREZ 410
obrez_410_2b077f4e.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT (OBREZ) into a modern day FROLOVKA OBREZ that fires 410 bore rounds!

obrez_8mm_conversion_d7825d3e.name: Obrez 8mm Conversion
obrez_8mm_conversion_d7825d3e.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that makes your Obrez Pistol fire the larger 8x50mmR cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a certain range. It does not perform as well at range, among other faults of the cartridge...

obrez_stock_11c92da0.name: Obrez Stock
obrez_stock_11c92da0.info: Reattach the stock to the OBREZ in order to decrease the recoil kick, at the cost of some other areas.

vks_suppressor_6663213f.name: VKS Suppressor
vks_suppressor_6663213f.info:
The iconic big suppressor for the VKS!
Excellent sound & radar masking while also improving bullet speed and penetration at the cost of some limb kill range and worse movement and handling.

vks_12_7x55mm_vps_a3fcd67d.name: VKS 12.7x55mm VPS
vks_12_7x55mm_vps_a3fcd67d.info: Load your VKS with 12.7x55mm VPS armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration, but halves your limb kill range while also lowering bullet speed and minimum damage due to overpenetration!

maxim_silencer_e8c9d176.name: Maxim Silencer
maxim_silencer_e8c9d176.info:
The first successful suppressor design.
An old suppressor from 1909 that saw limited use on the M1903 Springfield. Being one of the first suppressors, it is not as effective as modern ones available to you, but does have its own range of benefits.

air_service_barrel_373cc7bc.name: Air Service Barrel
air_service_barrel_373cc7bc.info: Barrel used on the Air Service M1903 Springfield rifle. Reduces weapon weight due to the lack of extra parts on the weapon, faster aimspeed.

air_service_mag_c20d52a3.name: Air Service Mag
air_service_mag_c20d52a3.info:
Fit your M1903 Springfield with a specialty magazine used in aircraft.
These were used as survival rifles in the instances of soliders becoming stranded after a crash. Very large magazine capacity with the expected downsides...

pedersen_device_1ec5cd20.name: Pedersen Device
pedersen_device_1ec5cd20.info:
The M1918 Pedersen Device was an experimental conversion for the M1903 firing the .30-18 Auto cartridge. Replacing a majority of your M1903 Springfields parts to allow it to fire in semi-automatic. Feeds from a large 40 round magazine.

Incompatible with the Marksman Kit.

unertl_8x_scope_b9697e2c.name: Unertl 8x Scope
unertl_8x_scope_b9697e2c.info: The standard issue scope for the Springfield M1903. This absurdly long target scope was designed by John Unertl and was found to be the best for the requirements of the military at the time.

hecate_cqb_barrel_b6ce3729.name: Hecate CQB Barrel
hecate_cqb_barrel_b6ce3729.info: Shortened barrel for the CQB Variant of the HECATE II. Not suited for long range engagements.

338_norma_fa8f7289.name: .338 Norma
338_norma_fa8f7289.info: Loads your Arctic Warfare with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it retains your one shot limb range while improving your firing speed!

awm_308_conversion_6ad8f319.name: AWM .308 Conversion
awm_308_conversion_6ad8f319.info: Changes the ammunition fired from your AWM into .308 Winchester effectively changing it into the AWP! A much lighter but still deadly ammo type still capable of an one shot limb kill but much shorter. Improves handling, recoil, firing speed and doubles your ammo capacity! Perfect to counter terrorism!

suppressor_railgun_975d0b3f.name: Suppressor (RAILGUN)
suppressor_railgun_975d0b3f.info:
50% muzzle velocity loss.
50 stud detection radius.

How on earth do you suppress this thing?

remove_irons_0f90273a.name: Remove Irons
remove_irons_0f90273a.info: You prefer to aim your gun with no assistance?

remove_irons_919b19b2.name: Remove Irons
remove_irons_919b19b2.info: You prefer to aim your gun with no assistance?

kek_50_long_barrel_723960fc.name: Kek-50 Long Barrel
kek_50_long_barrel_723960fc.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

7_5x55mm_swiss_wa2k_37020d91.name: 7.5x55mm Swiss (WA2K)
7_5x55mm_swiss_wa2k_37020d91.info: A cartridge introduced in 1898, originating from the 7.5x53.5mm cartridge. Allows the WA2000 to perform better at range, penetration and fire rate at the cost of velocity and a shortened torso kill!

300_win_magnum_wa2k_600f8eba.name: .300 Win-Magnum (WA2K)
300_win_magnum_wa2k_600f8eba.info:
A large cartridge introduced by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company in 1933.
Significantly powers up your WA2000 at the cost of ammo capacity and significantly higher recoil!

ballista_338_norma_5a0e5807.name: Ballista 338 Norma
ballista_338_norma_5a0e5807.info:
Loads your BALLISTA with .338 Norma Magnum.
This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length.
While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

ballista_308_win_7b771495.name: Ballista 308 Win
ballista_308_win_7b771495.info:
Converts your Ballista to fire .308 Winchester!
Faster cycling and an above average magazine capacity of 15 rounds with this lower caliber round but lowers damage and penetration!

ballista_300_win_mag_9f4be235.name: Ballista 300 Win Mag
ballista_300_win_mag_9f4be235.info:
Converts your Ballista to fire .300 Winchester Magnum!
A fast bottlenecked magnum rifle cartridge with great close range damage potentional and high muzzle velocity, but shortens the torso kill range and slows down your cycling rate! Magazine carries up to 10 rounds!

m110a1_aap_fec738f7.name: M110A1 AAP
m110a1_aap_fec738f7.info:
The XM1158 Advanced Armor Piercing Round is an armor piercing round replacing both the M80A1 and M993 rounds in 2020.
Significantly increases penetration and comes with a 20 round magazine at the cost of lower damage up close and to the torso!
Has typical extended magazine downsides!

braced_stock_ba3ef0b5.name: Braced Stock
braced_stock_ba3ef0b5.info: A braced stock with an ergonomic design that makes it faster to aim down the sights, while also improving gun sway while moving and while aiming down the sights. This stock also improves breath time on scopes and scope sway.

17_hmr_ruger_06316a1a.name: .17 HMR (Ruger)
17_hmr_ruger_06316a1a.info:
Converts your R-10/22 rifle to fire .17 HMR, providing excellent velocity and long-range headshot performance. This conversion kit also comes with a modified charging handle that makes the gun manually operated, acting as a straight-pull bolt action!

Animation likely completely broken, WIP.

22_win_magnum_ruger_c1f241f9.name: .22 Win Magnum (Ruger)
22_win_magnum_ruger_c1f241f9.info: Loads your .22LR rifle with higher-power magnum rounds, improving performance against the body while reducing it against the head.

olympian_target_sight_b982976f.name: Olympian Target Sight
olympian_target_sight_b982976f.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

olympian_target_sight_132fcec7.name: Olympian Target Sight
olympian_target_sight_132fcec7.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

olympian_target_sight_0fbe7777.name: Olympian Target Sight
olympian_target_sight_0fbe7777.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

trg_260_f0ab824b.name: TRG 260
trg_260_f0ab824b.info: A conversion kit to transform your gun into the TRG-22, firing the .260 Remington cartridge. Less power, more maneuverability. Comes with a brand new bolt to make cycling much easier!

338_norma_trg_42_7dbd0888.name: .338 Norma (TRG-42)
338_norma_trg_42_7dbd0888.info: Loads your TRG with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

trg_375_f891da76.name: TRG 375
trg_375_f891da76.info: A conversion kit that transforms the gun into the TRG-S, firing the famed .30-06 cartridge. Trades performance at range for a significantly long one-shot kill to any part of the body.

sako_backup_sight_a8392683.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_a8392683.info: Alternate iron sights for the Sako TRG-42.

ft300_extended_magazine_5c64f25e.name: FT300 Extended Magazine
ft300_extended_magazine_5c64f25e.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 10 rounds combined with a straight pull bolt, but lessen certain mobility traits.

ft300_suppressor_15296258.name: FT300 Suppressor
ft300_suppressor_15296258.info: An integral suppressor for the FT300 competition rifle. Preserve damage, range and increases the torso multiplier in exchange for poorer velocity. Lower suppression radius.

ft300_wood_furniture_196c8e78.name: FT300 Wood Furniture
ft300_wood_furniture_196c8e78.info:
Replaces the standard furniture of your weapon stock for something a bit more classic.
This wood furniture improves a variety of aspects of your weapon to allow it to be best suited for long range engagements.

ft300_wood_furniture_2db53122.name: FT300 Wood Furniture
ft300_wood_furniture_2db53122.info:
Replaces the standard furniture of your weapon stock for something a bit more classic.
This wood furniture improves a variety of aspects of your weapon to allow it to be best suited for long range engagements.

olympic_forgrip_51d19f47.name: Olympic Forgrip
olympic_forgrip_51d19f47.info:
This grip is counterweighted to help improve how fast you can aim.
Ideal for taking aim at targets faster with small improvements to your sway and steady time, offset with hindered walkspeed while aiming.

ft300_6xc_2d5098ac.name: FT300 6XC
ft300_6xc_2d5098ac.info:
Load your FT300 with the 6XC wildcat cartridge.
Offering poorer close range performance to the .243 winchester cartridge, but it is preferred for long range usage with its slightly improved velocity and ranges due to weight and a faster reload and action time. Small increase to penetration.

ft300_308_112b9ae2.name: FT300 308
ft300_308_112b9ae2.info:
Load your FT300 with the .308 Winchester cartridge.
A heavier cartridge than .243 Winchester with a slightly lower velocity. More power with improved performance in long range, good if you want something between power for close range engagements and velocity for longer range engagements.

ft300_22lr_96a88937.name: FT300 22LR
ft300_22lr_96a88937.info:
Load your FT300 with the .22 Long Rifle cartridge.
This ammo type deals poorer damage in long range to the body and limbs, but still competes due to a fast reload and surprisingly high torso damage. Does not pair with the Marksman Kit and will always single load ammunition. No reserve ammo.

ft300_7_5_5c639167.name: FT300 7.5
ft300_7_5_5c639167.info:
Load your FT300 with the 7.5x55mm Swiss cartridge.
A heavier cartridge doing greater damage across range to an enemies torso, but travels slower with a slower reload. Higher penetration.

long_barrel_ntw_20_92170600.name: Long Barrel (NTW-20)
long_barrel_ntw_20_92170600.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

ntw_obrez_barrel_7fd334c1.name: NTW Obrez Barrel
ntw_obrez_barrel_7fd334c1.info: An even shorter barrel for the NTW-20, made by a deaf gunsmith. Provides an exaggerated version of the short barrel stats, good and bad. You are able to stand while aiming with this equipped.

ntw_14_5_conversion_03c838f9.name: NTW 14.5 Conversion
ntw_14_5_conversion_03c838f9.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 14.5x114mm.
 This turns the weapon into the  NTW-14.5, Keeping the 3 round magazine and giving more optimal sniper rifle performance.

ntw_20_conversion_20c759e2.name: NTW 20 Conversion
ntw_20_conversion_20c759e2.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 20x110mm Hispano-Suiza.

Improves muzzle velocity and damage per shot, but reduces overall penetration.

short_chop_95c5e869.name: Short Chop
short_chop_95c5e869.info: Equip your Fix with the Short Chop, a medium suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Increases ranges, deadly quiet. Do not use to break boards. 30 Stud detection radius.

porq_chop_5ff25295.name: PORQ Chop
porq_chop_5ff25295.info: Equip your Fix with the PorQ Chop, a heavy suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Reduced velocity, deadly quiet. Improves CQC Torso ranges. Do not eat.

tfix_308_773359e2.name: TFIX 308
tfix_308_773359e2.info: Swap your caliber over to .308 Win. Increases magazine capacity, velocity, and treats your rifle closer to a standard light sniper.

tfix_65cree_742afe0d.name: TFIX 65Cree
tfix_65cree_742afe0d.info: Swap your caliber over to 6.5 Creedmoor. Faster projectile velocity and improved performance at longer range.

k14_308_winchester_80dcae3c.name: K14 .308 Winchester
k14_308_winchester_80dcae3c.info:
Load your K14 with .308 Winchester.
Fitted with a 5 round magazine, the K14 gains more favourable sniper traits with additional reload speed, but less rounds are carried.

cheytac_cqb_barrel_954f6cb8.name: CheyTac CQB Barrel
cheytac_cqb_barrel_954f6cb8.info: Shortened homemade barrel modification for the M200 Intervention. Not suited for long range engagements.

375_cheytac_45bf9b1a.name: .375 CheyTac
375_cheytac_45bf9b1a.info:
Load your Intervention with .375 CheyTac.
The alternative ammo that the Intervention can be made to fire featuring faster muzzle velocity but reduced penetration and range.

short_barrel_sweetspot_7bae6cca.name: Short Barrel (Sweetspot)
short_barrel_sweetspot_7bae6cca.info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and close range performance. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet penetration and velocity.

short_barrel_sweetspot_7657bda3.name: Short Barrel (Sweetspot)
short_barrel_sweetspot_7657bda3.info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and close range performance. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet penetration and velocity.

timberwolf_suppressor_ce8aced0.name: Timberwolf Suppressor
timberwolf_suppressor_ce8aced0.info:
A military suppressor for the C14 sniper system with a (relatively) compact barrel profile.

Slight increase in maximum torso kill range and lowers recoil at the cost of a mild reduction of penetration and aim walkspeed

long_barrel_sweetspot_e071f1e1.name: Long Barrel (Sweetspot)
long_barrel_sweetspot_e071f1e1.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

long_barrel_sweetspot_6e080496.name: Long Barrel (Sweetspot)
long_barrel_sweetspot_6e080496.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

long_barrel_sweetspot_413cfa55.name: Long Barrel (Sweetspot)
long_barrel_sweetspot_413cfa55.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

timberwolf_338_norma_365d7425.name: Timberwolf .338 Norma
timberwolf_338_norma_365d7425.info:
Loads your C14 with .338 Norma Magnum.
This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length.
While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

timberwolf_308_72d7b949.name: Timberwolf .308
timberwolf_308_72d7b949.info:
A .308 Winchester conversion kit for the Timberwolf, turning it into the lighter Coyote rifle.
Possesses a simpler damage profile that allows you to kill to the torso up close, but lacks the raw power and performance of the other available ammo types.

timberwolf_408_6b576b45.name: Timberwolf .408
timberwolf_408_6b576b45.info:
A .408 Chey Tac conversion kit for the Timberwolf rifle.
Possesses much higher damage and penetrative power, but comes at the cost of being more cumbersome to use.

scout_5_56_conversion_2ca688f1.name: Scout 5.56 Conversion
scout_5_56_conversion_2ca688f1.info: Load your Scout rifle with .223, a more common civilian ammunition with slightly improved handling characteristics and even more abysmal body damage.

376_scout_5cae74d1.name: 376 SCOUT
376_scout_5cae74d1.info: Change the ammunition fired from your Scout rifle into 9.5x59mmRB for big game hunting. This larger bore round is much more potent in closer engagements, and increases muzzle velocity. However, magazine capacity is severely reduced and rounds must be reloaded manually.

dsr_light_stock_b136b938.name: DSR Light Stock
dsr_light_stock_b136b938.info:
A lighter version of the DSR-50's stock.
Improves mobility and handling speed but increases recoil due to missing recoil buffer parts. Increases weapon sway when scoping and walking.

dsr_remove_mag_db86a455.name: DSR Remove Mag
dsr_remove_mag_db86a455.info:
Removes the front magazine from your gun to lower its weight, increasing mobility while aiming and handling speed.
But this lowers your reserve ammo pool.

m107_50_cal_drum_e9410778.name: M107 .50 Cal Drum
m107_50_cal_drum_e9410778.info: A 20 round drum magazine for a .50 Cal anti-materiel rifle.

m107_reduced_magazine_015a1180.name: M107 Reduced Magazine
m107_reduced_magazine_015a1180.info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

m107_unfolded_bipod_9d54a977.name: M107 Unfolded Bipod
m107_unfolded_bipod_9d54a977.info:
Unfolds the bipod from your gun allowing you to mount it on the ground while crouching, prone or near a valid spot! Cannot aim otherwise!
When aimed in, cannot move and slows down unaiming speed but greatly decreases gun kick and improves accuracy!

barrett_cqb_barrel_21263479.name: Barrett CQB Barrel
barrett_cqb_barrel_21263479.info:
A short CQB barrel for the M82A1M. Not suited for long range engagements.
Lowers maximum and minimum ranges required to torso kill, but also penetration and bullet speed. May not always be 100% accurate!
Improves walk speed and handling significantly!

m107_rat_shot_7db0b661.name: M107 Rat Shot
m107_rat_shot_7db0b661.info:
So instead of using standard .50 BMG rounds, you are using .50 BMG rat shot. Why would you load your rifle with rat shot? What kind of rats are you against?
I don't see really big rats...

m107_17_wildcat_634e3f9f.name: M107 .17 Wildcat
m107_17_wildcat_634e3f9f.info:
Why would you do this...?

Wildcat .50 BMG cartridge made to fire a tiny little .17 caliber bullet.
The speed of the bullet is unmatched.

m107_m903_slap_5df56b4d.name: M107 M903 SLAP
m107_m903_slap_5df56b4d.info:
Nothing can stop you now.
Saboted light armor penetrator rounds made specifically to penetrate as many walls of armor as physically possible. Reduces overall damage, but up bullet speed and penetration.

m107_416_barrett_cba1e41f.name: M107 .416 Barrett
m107_416_barrett_cba1e41f.info:
Proprietary bottlenecked centrefire rifle cartridge designed in 2005. It is an alternative to the .50 BMG cartidge.
Faster muzzle velocity but reduced range effectiveness.

aftermarket_sight_b49e03ea.name: Aftermarket Sight
aftermarket_sight_b49e03ea.info: Special aftermarket iron sights for the M82A1!

remington_700_32_acp_adapter_07b23d6e.name: Remington 700 .32 ACP Adapter
remington_700_32_acp_adapter_07b23d6e.info:
Not you again!
Simple metal adapters allow the use of 7.65mm rounds without any major modifications.
Vastly improved weapon speed, including action and reloading with poor damage and velocity as a tradeoff because your absolute priority is speed.

bfg_carbine_barrel_6368d7b6.name: BFG Carbine Barrel
bfg_carbine_barrel_6368d7b6.info:
A shortened barrel that turns your gun into the BFG 50 CARBINE!
This lighter 22 inch barrel increases walk speed and handling speeds at a mild cost of bullet speed and penetration.
Accurate enough to still be useful for sniping!

10_3_5mm_724cb726.name: 10/3.5mm
10_3_5mm_724cb726.info:
An obscure Zarovian cartridge that can be loaded in 7.62x54mmR weapons including your SVDS!
It is a dart encased in a sabot allowing it to fly incredibly fast with great potential in penetrating softer materials but not great at shooting limbs due to overpenetration!
Very powerful headshot damage and fast fire rate!

svds_953_conversion_431d89d0.name: SVDS 953 Conversion
svds_953_conversion_431d89d0.info:
Load your SVDS with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

cs_lr_4a_308_winchester_b1c3f0f2.name: CS/LR-4A .308 Winchester
cs_lr_4a_308_winchester_b1c3f0f2.info: Rechambers your Jinhanian sniper rifle in .308 Winchester, increasing damage range, bullet speed and penetration but also recoil and cuts down your reserves. Slower cycling rate!

aws_subsonic_ammo_776f86d0.name: AWS Subsonic Ammo
aws_subsonic_ammo_776f86d0.info:
Subsonic 7.62x51mm NATO made specifically for the AWS.

Noise levels are comparable to .22LR match ammunition at the cost of muzzle velocity.

Introduces unique one shot kill ranges with its heavier grain projectile.

Greatly reduces the suppression effect so enemies will not know you are shooting at them.

mosin_410_b9339f1a.name: MOSIN 410
mosin_410_b9339f1a.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT into a modern day FROLOVKA that fires 410 bore rounds!

mosin_8mm_conversion_38eb6ee3.name: Mosin 8mm Conversion
mosin_8mm_conversion_38eb6ee3.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that allows your Mosin-Nagant to fire the larger 8x50mmR Mannlicher cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a decently far range. But the cartridge faults allow it to not keep standard sniper rifle traits too well.

heavy_bolt_df659cb3.name: Heavy Bolt
heavy_bolt_df659cb3.info: The bolt is replaced by a much heavier one made by Beretta, slowing down the RPM and general mobility but makes the gun easier to control.

aug_hbar_closed_bolt_conversion_b11d1073.name: AUG HBAR Closed Bolt Conversion
aug_hbar_closed_bolt_conversion_b11d1073.info: Convert your UAR HEAVY to fire from a closed bolt. Reduces weapon firerate and gives it more general accuracy in exchange. Can load an extra round in the chamber!

fal_marksman_stock_946854f2.name: FAL Marksman Stock
fal_marksman_stock_946854f2.info: Improves your cheekweld for better control over recoil while aiming but slightly reduces your aimspeed getting into position.

fal_prs_full_stock_c14f3582.name: FAL PRS Full Stock
fal_prs_full_stock_c14f3582.info: PRS full polymer stock. Modern lightweight solution for making your FAL more ergonomic to handle. Moderately increases camera recoil

falo_50_41_10rnd_0fb5b70f.name: FALO 50.41 10rnd
falo_50_41_10rnd_0fb5b70f.info:
An even smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But significantly improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!
At this point, is this even a LMG anymore?

falo_50_41_20rnd_00ff7c77.name: FALO 50.41 20rnd
falo_50_41_20rnd_00ff7c77.info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

falo_50_41_drum_cc4132c5.name: FALO 50.41 Drum
falo_50_41_drum_cc4132c5.info: 50rd X-FAL drum magazine! Gives you the true FAL LMG experience by giving you 50 rounds of ammo! But reloads slow and will lower your walkspeed and handling.

rpk12_7_62_conversion_739d306e.name: RPK12 7.62 Conversion
rpk12_7_62_conversion_739d306e.info:
A conversion kit chambering the RPK-12 for 7.62x39mm, designed as a potential replacement for the RPK in service to go alongside the 5.45x39 upgrade.

Increased damage and recoil with slightly less magazine capacity and a slightly longer reload time.

m60_5_56_0c3f2fdc.name: M60 5.56
m60_5_56_0c3f2fdc.info:
A 5.56x45mm NATO conversion kit for the M60 machine gun.

With no military applications and very little civil interest in it, it inevitably faded into obscurity.

But hey - I'm sure you can find a use for it, right? We'll even throw in a new fire selector that allows for semi-automatic and fully-automatic fire, free of charge!

m60_depleted_uranium_ec5a343b.name: M60 Depleted Uranium
m60_depleted_uranium_ec5a343b.info:
Load your M60 with 30 rounds of surplus D.U.D.S (Depleted Uranium Discarding Sabots)

Significantly reduced capacity and greatly increased penetration depth. Uranium Fever has done and got me down!

m60_assault_box_6d4e8874.name: M60 Assault Box
m60_assault_box_6d4e8874.info:
A smaller 50rd ammo box that also reduces ammo reserve.

Great benefit in movement and handling and a slightly faster reload time.

Slightly increases rising recoil and vertical camera kick.

mgv176_folded_40fa4ae6.name: MGV176 Folded
mgv176_folded_40fa4ae6.info: Folds your stock. Adds to your vertical and horizontal recoil by 30%.

mgv176_folded_b27d0f85.name: MGV176 Folded
mgv176_folded_b27d0f85.info: Folds your stock. Adds to your vertical and horizontal recoil by 30%.

pkm_fsds_7de7c12c.name: PKM FSDS
pkm_fsds_7de7c12c.info:
Loads your weapon with 10/4.5x54mm FSDS rounds.
It is a dart encased in a sabot allowing it to fly incredibly fast with greater penetration materials while having lighter recoil, but reduces damage significantly.
Greater headshot damage and comes with lighter gun parts for your PK's which improve mobility and handling!
Shots may deviate from the center.

ak12br_7_62_conversion_ff2b80b2.name: AK12BR 7.62 Conversion
ak12br_7_62_conversion_ff2b80b2.info:
A conversion kit that rechambered the AK-12BR prototype for 7.62x39mm, using a more conventional drum magazine.
Lower recoil for the caliber, but also lower damage. High rate of fire.

light_bolt_mg42_e5ce3d28.name: Light Bolt (MG42)
light_bolt_mg42_e5ce3d28.info: The bolt is replaced by a much lighter one, increasing the RPM and some mobility but making the gun harder to control!

heavy_bolt_mg42_240762d8.name: Heavy Bolt (MG42)
heavy_bolt_mg42_240762d8.info: The bolt is replaced by a much heavier one, slowing down the RPM and movement but making the gun easier to control.

rpk_75rd_drum_06da29a4.name: RPK 75rd Drum
rpk_75rd_drum_06da29a4.info: Replaces your 40rd magazine with a 75rd Drum Magazine! Significantly increases ammo capacity and reserve while also reducing vertical updrift thanks to the weight! Takes a while to reload and weighs down your firearm while also making horizontal recoil slightly less controllable!

colt_lmg_25_45_conversion_541dff22.name: Colt LMG 25-45 Conversion
colt_lmg_25_45_conversion_541dff22.info:
Loads your LSV M/04 with .20 Tactical.
This uses the typical 30-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

special_alexandrite_b5f7028b.name: Special Alexandrite
special_alexandrite_b5f7028b.info: Uses special Alexandrite inside a .308 casing! This gem magically allows you to alter your gun performance, starting at its normal performance, then flip the switch to make it fire at half the fire rate but significantly improves recoil! Additionally, this gem also boosts your velocity significantly and the thinner nature allows you to carry 50 extra rounds in your box, but it is not so good at suppression!

topaz_hunter_8b45fde0.name: Topaz Hunter
topaz_hunter_8b45fde0.info: Uses an energetic Topaz inside a .308 casing! This gem turns your gun into a belt fed DMR, dealing very high damage especially to the torso and head capable of one shotting in the torso up close and a guaranteed kill in the head at any range! Can only carry half the magazine capacity due to the thicker round but this improves overall handling aswell!

amethyst_stream_3b7ee505.name: Amethyst Stream
amethyst_stream_3b7ee505.info: Uses pure Amethyst inside a .308 casing! Magically converts your gun into a 10 round burst rapid firing storm gun, but has a lengthy cooldown due to overheating! Comes with 2 extra boxes of ammo!

subsonic_ruby_2993e20a.name: Subsonic Ruby
subsonic_ruby_2993e20a.info: Uses the soft heavy Ruby inside a .308 casing! Due to the softer nature of this gem, your gun is now subsonic and allows it to fire insanely fast! Or can be switched to fire slower for better accuracy! Sound, suppression and radar detection are fully masked and close range damage is increased but at the cost of heavy reduction in velocity and ranged performance!

sapphire_edge_42b03a18.name: Sapphire Edge
sapphire_edge_42b03a18.info: Uses the sharp edges of Sapphire inside a .308 casing! Magically reduces reload time and even more if it's empty while also being semi good at penetration and never loses power over range! However it does deal less damage up close, lower velocity and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!

onyx_shards_28fc0ac8.name: Onyx Shards
onyx_shards_28fc0ac8.info: Uses a large Onyx gem inside a .308 casing! This thick stone breaks off instantly into many shards once fired, these shards are very sharp and pierce through a lot of material dealing high damage! These Onyx bullets are so thick that it requires manual rechambering and limits your box ammo quantity to only 20!

rare_painite_bc85b5a8.name: Rare Painite
rare_painite_bc85b5a8.info: Uses very rare Painite inside a .308 casing! This special gem truly inflicts the PAIN on your enemy by improving weapon performance and damage significantly without any visible drawbacks! However, due to how rare this gem is: you have only been able to bring 1 box of it! So if you run out, the fun is over!

emerald_beam_8731783d.name: Emerald Beam
emerald_beam_8731783d.info: Uses small Emerald rocks inside a .308 casing! These fly and accelerate extremely fast and nullifies all recoil to the point your gun is now a hitscan! Alongside that, doubles your magazine capacity with infinite reserve and a faster reload! However these rocks deal very little damage but ramp up a little over range!

quartz_storm_dcb80475.name: Quartz Storm
quartz_storm_dcb80475.info: Uses brittle Quartz inside a .308 casing! Easily breaks off when fired, resulting in 3 pieces flying wild and falls straight down like a brick at range! Very deadly damage up close but falls off hard and is weak at range!

diamond_point_1e61540b.name: Diamond Point
diamond_point_1e61540b.info: Uses very sharp Diamond points inside a .308 casing! These are very powerful at penetrating deep into hard surfaces and dealing massive damage to the body and head but weak against limbs due to overpenetration and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!

mg36_300_conversion_4e030538.name: MG36 .300 Conversion
mg36_300_conversion_4e030538.info:
Load your MG91 with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group, it offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

30rd_stanag_020c2a13.name: 30rd STANAG
30rd_stanag_020c2a13.info: Load your rifle with a shorter 30rd STANAG magazine. Less rounds carried with greater mobility. Slightly more recoil as a result of losing weight on the weapon.

hamr_9mm_conversion_9a3821a5.name: HAMR 9mm Conversion
hamr_9mm_conversion_9a3821a5.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR into 9x19mm using a conversion kit by Big Woods MFG.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

hamr_6_8spc_conversion_c19a2178.name: HAMR 6.8SPC Conversion
hamr_6_8spc_conversion_c19a2178.info: Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR to 6.8x43mm SPC. Improved damage output at the cost of recoil control.

m249_chainsaw_kit_f6254887.name: M249 Chainsaw Kit
m249_chainsaw_kit_f6254887.info:
Special chainsaw kit for the M249 SAW, greatly improving hipfire control, recoil and stability but can make aimed fire more difficult! Also lowers aim walkspeed and handling!
Cannot be combined with grips!

m249_30rd_stanag_e8ce42da.name: M249 30rd STANAG
m249_30rd_stanag_e8ce42da.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a standard 30rd STANAG magazine, sacrificing a lot of ammo for a lot more mobility, faster handling and shorter reload time!
Very large ammo pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight.
Movement and handling is still heavier than a standard assault rifle!

m249_200rd_box_b8a8d2ec.name: M249 200rd Box
m249_200rd_box_b8a8d2ec.info:
A large 200 round box for the M249 SAW, this should let you last for a long while!
Comes at a significant cost of movement speed, handling and reload time due to the weight!

m249_60rd_casket_9e4be2ed.name: M249 60rd Casket
m249_60rd_casket_9e4be2ed.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a 60rd STANAG casket magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Large ammo reserve pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight and will take longer to reload when empty!

rpk_16_60rd_b05be651.name: RPK-16 60rd
rpk_16_60rd_b05be651.info:
Loads your RPK-16 with a 60rd magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Larger ammo reserve pool, slightly increased handling and mobility speeds but also slightly increased recoil from the reduced weight.

33rd_mag_d04b276f.name: 33rd Mag
33rd_mag_d04b276f.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G17 and G18. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

33rd_mag_1ccea583.name: 33rd Mag
33rd_mag_1ccea583.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G17 and G18. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

glock_stock_2_b92e5a5d.name: Glock Stock 2
glock_stock_2_b92e5a5d.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which folds over in front of your G-Series pistol. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

glock_stock_folded_4ca51008.name: Glock Stock Folded
glock_stock_folded_4ca51008.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which you have folded over in front of your G-Series pistol. Now you have a foregrip! Featuring similar attributes to the Angled Grip.

skorp_9x18mm_conversion_cb6fef11.name: SKORP 9x18mm Conversion
skorp_9x18mm_conversion_cb6fef11.info:
Load your Skorpion with 9x18mm Makarov.
Loading from a 30 round magazine, you lose a small amount of close range performance with reduced damage in range while retaining the same range profile. Higher bullet velocity and a higher firerate.

skorp_rubber_bullets_57bc88b5.name: SKORP Rubber Bullets
skorp_rubber_bullets_57bc88b5.info:
Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Rubber Bullets.
Ammunition usually used by police in riot control. Improved damage to the body which falls off tremendously fast.

skorp_rat_shot_4e7a975d.name: SKORP Rat Shot
skorp_rat_shot_4e7a975d.info: Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Ratshot. Make those shots count; with a small magazine size, Ratshot is very effective at close range but is extremely ineffective at longer ranges.

skorp_rate_limiter_665fc0f5.name: SKORP Rate Limiter
skorp_rate_limiter_665fc0f5.info: Removes the firerate limiter from your Skorpion machine pistol granting it to be fired faster. A drawback to removing the limiter will severely impact your weapons recoil.

extended_stock_alt_d96c4821.name: Extended Stock (ALT)
extended_stock_alt_d96c4821.info: Fold out the weapon's stock for greater stability.

aek_919k_pms_suppressor_b5d9515d.name: AEK-919K PMS Suppressor
aek_919k_pms_suppressor_b5d9515d.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A special suppressor for the AEK-919K that increases your headshot damage while mildly reducing vertical recoil and increasing range.
Reduces damage over range and mildly reduces mobility and handling.

9x18mm_7n25_4d2ccf8f.name: 9x18mm 7N25
9x18mm_7n25_4d2ccf8f.info:
For 9x18mm firearms.
Changes your ammunition to the 7N25 variant.
Increases torso damage multiplier (+10%) but also significantly increases bullet velocity (+50%) and penetration (+140%) while cutting down overall damage & range (-10%) and head damage multiplier (-7.5%).

muzi_strike_3_5e4ce56e.name: MUZI Strike-3
muzi_strike_3_5e4ce56e.info:
Specially made 9x19mm shells loaded with three #1 buckshot pellets. Never made it past experimental stages... Until now.
If you're looking for a bullet hose, this is the ammo type for you.

muzi_45_acp_3e23ba4c.name: MUZI 45 ACP
muzi_45_acp_3e23ba4c.info: Convert your Micro Uzi into the civilian variant that fires .45 ACP in semi auto with stats to match the change.

aws_9mm_conversion_a9ca4abb.name: AWS 9mm Conversion
aws_9mm_conversion_a9ca4abb.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AWS 1911 into 9x19mm.
A weaker but much more accurate round fired faster than you could imagine!
Comes in a 20 round magazine, and an extra spare mag!

long_barrel_rev_87ecb449.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_87ecb449.info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

long_barrel_rev_64ad248e.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_64ad248e.info: Yee-Haw! Get yourself a horse-rider's barrel and start shootin'! Increased muzzle velocity means you can down that honcho on the far side of the town before he can get you!

long_barrel_rev_fd9ce203.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_fd9ce203.info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

long_barrel_rev_f563d6e7.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_f563d6e7.info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

snubnose_barrel_af51d56d.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_af51d56d.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

snubnose_barrel_510a54ee.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_510a54ee.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

snubnose_barrel_e42ac278.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_e42ac278.info: Less is more when it comes to being snubby. Usually reserved for the Noir side of things, but it will certainly help when your stakeout goes south. Significantly reduced muzzle velocity.

snubnose_barrel_c9e68529.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_c9e68529.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

integral_suppressor_goldhawk_e51875c9.name: Integral Suppressor (GOLDHAWK)
integral_suppressor_goldhawk_e51875c9.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the .300 BLK SCAR SC and intended for police usage.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walk speed and handling!

kac_stock_b19f365b.name: KAC Stock
kac_stock_b19f365b.info:
The R SQUARED stock taken off and placed onto the RH-44.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

rsh_9_conversion_d16c0682.name: RSH-9 Conversion
rsh_9_conversion_d16c0682.info:
A conversion for the RSH-12.
Trades off the stopping power of 12.7x55mm for the slightly better ballistics of 9x39mm SP, along with less recoil!
Changes the gun's name to the RSH-9!

1858_long_barrel_8942e99e.name: 1858 Long Barrel
1858_long_barrel_8942e99e.info: Long barrel designed specifically for the 1858 line of revolvers. Increases range and bullet velocity but with worse handling.

1858_snake_shot_b3576c85.name: 1858 Snake Shot
1858_snake_shot_b3576c85.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 357 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.

36_caliber_na_f6187757.name: .36 Caliber NA
36_caliber_na_f6187757.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

short_barrel_rex_439ee26b.name: Short Barrel REX
short_barrel_rex_439ee26b.info: Reduce your barrel length to give yourself the legendary MP412 REX. Despite never reaching sales, it has seen the faces of battlefields across the world. You'll never be in bad company with this by your side!

longest_rex_68f75509.name: Longest REX
longest_rex_68f75509.info: Sometimes, all you need is a really long barrel. Sadly, y'ain't a ranger, but you do got this on your hip! Reduced muzzle flip with massively increased range so you can clear leather long before your opponent ever can.

integral_rex_bfaefaef.name: Integral REX
integral_rex_bfaefaef.info: A custom built Monarch barrel for the MP412. Tight tolerances and a near non-existent cylinder gap allows it to be fully suppressed. Dominate the competition and show everyone who is king. Decent masking range at the cost of a significantly reduced velocity.

rex_stock_850029d1.name: Rex Stock
rex_stock_850029d1.info: Custom built stock for the MP412. Based on the average pistol stock, it allows for greater stability while firing. For some reason this is considered a big no-no for some folks, however you are in an active warzone so that doesn't matter.

44_special_1b136778.name: .44 Special
44_special_1b136778.info:
Specialty ammo made for the .44 magnum caliber with the intent of more controllable power.
Less recoil results in greater accuracy, however poorer ranges in exchange for retaining damage.

redhawk_45_colt_b0dee74a.name: Redhawk 45 Colt
redhawk_45_colt_b0dee74a.info: Convert your Redhawk 44 into a Redhawk 45, making it fire the 45 colt cartridge in single action! It will become much stronger in close range, but be slower and hampered at longer ranges.

mateba_6_454_casull_68428336.name: Mateba 6 .454 Casull
mateba_6_454_casull_68428336.info: Chambers your Mateba Autorevolver in .454 Casull - giving it a massive increase in stopping power up close at the cost of having a lower rate of fire, increased recoil, and slightly worse handling.

taurus_barrel_judge_6d30bd2b.name: Taurus Barrel (Judge)
taurus_barrel_judge_6d30bd2b.info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revolver.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

judge_slugs_5ef396aa.name: Judge Slugs
judge_slugs_5ef396aa.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

taurus_stock_12740c64.name: Taurus Stock
taurus_stock_12740c64.info:
The Taurus carbine kit stock placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

taurus_barrel_f32b4fd8.name: Taurus Barrel
taurus_barrel_f32b4fd8.info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

dbv_30_06_conversion_cb458abc.name: DBV 30-06 Conversion
dbv_30_06_conversion_cb458abc.info:
A 30-06 conversion kit for the AK-12/76, with a rifled barrel and bolt capable of handling the new round. A popular sporting cartridge, the 30-06 round packs a powerful punch at all ranges.

Very high damage with a below average rate of fire.

dbv_410_conversion_3f0cdefe.name: DBV .410 Conversion
dbv_410_conversion_3f0cdefe.info:
A conversion kit for the .410 shotgun round using a modified trigger group designed to fire in two-round bursts.

Reduced pellet count, but with increased damage per pellet, magazine capacity, and overall rate of fire.

spas_12_pump_action_f226948f.name: SPAS-12 Pump-Action
spas_12_pump_action_f226948f.info:
Switch the firemode to pump-action typically used for lower pressure rounds.
Better accuracy, worse RPM.
Free!

cobray_bolo_round_aa8cb916.name: COBRAY Bolo Round
cobray_bolo_round_aa8cb916.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

long_barrel_shotgun_c995d73d.name: Long Barrel (SHOTGUN)
long_barrel_shotgun_c995d73d.info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

long_barrel_shotgun_6a7e4384.name: Long Barrel (SHOTGUN)
long_barrel_shotgun_6a7e4384.info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

long_barrel_shotgun_4d0581c6.name: Long Barrel (SHOTGUN)
long_barrel_shotgun_4d0581c6.info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

long_barrel_shotgun_6baa732c.name: Long Barrel (SHOTGUN)
long_barrel_shotgun_6baa732c.info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

dt_olympian_stock_3fdaa05d.name: DT Olympian Stock
dt_olympian_stock_3fdaa05d.info: Adjustable stock found on the DT11 PRO. It will certainly cushion the recoil but you will not lose out on mobility. However aiming is slower.

dt_sporting_stock_e0f2d882.name: DT Sporting Stock
dt_sporting_stock_e0f2d882.info: A sturdy stock found on the DT11 ACS. It will certainly aid in recoil control for any situation, but the weight may become a hinderance for movement.

sawed_off_barrel_3fc46d8b.name: Sawed Off Barrel
sawed_off_barrel_3fc46d8b.info:
A super short sawed-off barrel for your DT11 shotgun.
Further improves close range performance, reloads are a breeze but spread is massively increased.

suppressor_dt11_299c0d9c.name: Suppressor (DT11)
suppressor_dt11_299c0d9c.info: Integral Suppressor for your competition shotgun. Preserves range and damage and the weight reduces felt weapon recoil. With small velocity, spread and weight penalties.

combat_barrel_dt11_1e867554.name: Combat Barrel (DT11)
combat_barrel_dt11_1e867554.info: A medium length barrel perfect for just about any engagement in normal circumstances. Improves close range performance slightly, speeds reload time and increases spread.

000_buckshot_306b36c1.name: #000 Buckshot
000_buckshot_306b36c1.info:
Changes your shot load to #000 buckshot, one the largest diameter pellets commercially available, perfect for hunting and for self defence.
Large pellets dealing high damage to enemies, with greater spread and penetration but lower pellet velocity.

bolo_round_76881a2e.name: Bolo Round
bolo_round_76881a2e.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

3_shell_8ba107dc.name: 3½ Shell
3_shell_8ba107dc.info:
Changes your shot load to 3½ inch buckshot shells.
8 pellets of #00 buckshot in a 3½ inch super-duper magnum shell packed to the brim with as much powder as you could possibly want.
Increases velocity making hitting targets in range easier. Yes, it's actually called a super-duper magnum.

dt_siege_sight_a36af556.name: DT Siege Sight
dt_siege_sight_a36af556.info: The perfect sight for takin' down them no good dirty scoundrels held up in that thar' darn house!

dt11_target_sight_cb102c64.name: DT11 Target Sight
dt11_target_sight_cb102c64.info: An elevated sight typically used for target shootin'.

usas_12_semi_conversion_a27b071d.name: USAS-12 Semi Conversion
usas_12_semi_conversion_a27b071d.info:
Change the internals of your USAS-12 to make it able to fire in semi-automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less firerate. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

barrikada_932b786e.name: Barrikada
barrikada_932b786e.info: Changes your shot load to Barrikada. Known as 'Barricade' in English, fire a large solid steel projectile much like a slug with the capabilities of destroying a cars engine block at up to 100 meters. Increased projectile speed with high damage to the head at range. Incredible penetration potential.

ks_harpoon_83088d8b.name: KS HARPOON
ks_harpoon_83088d8b.info:
Muzzle load a harpoon into your KS-23M.
 Ignoring the lack of the rope typically attached, this uses an overpressured blank shell to propel the harpoon way over yonder!

volna_r_251c957f.name: Volna-R
volna_r_251c957f.info: Changes your shot load to Volna-R. Known as 'Wave' in English, fire a single large rubber slug used for less than lethal purposes. But less than lethal is still lethal, and a large 23mm rubber ball is about to prove that with incredibly high damage to the body and limbs, but the actual rubber slug itself travels slowly.

ks_4g_6f6ca148.name: KS 4G
ks_4g_6f6ca148.info:
An incredibly large shotgun shell typically used for shooting waterfowl or big game in long range. Typically sold in the civilian market. Almost guaranteed to take multiple targets in a single shot!
Contains a large wide-spread amount of pellets with higher penetration with reduced damage, but powerful enough to annihilate anything in your path!
Takes extra time and care to rechamber!

shrapnel_25_6a61204c.name: Shrapnel-25
shrapnel_25_6a61204c.info: Changes your shot load to Shrapnel-25. Saboted 23mm shells designed to keep the buckshot close to the center of the barrel making shots at range much easier to hit consistently. Reduces spread dramatically but lowers individual pellet damage.

gs_slam_fire_01e2d625.name: GS Slam Fire
gs_slam_fire_01e2d625.info: Allows your Golden Shorty to slam fire at a fast rate by holding down the firing button at the cost of larger spread!

aa_12_semi_conversion_4c645e0a.name: AA-12 Semi Conversion
aa_12_semi_conversion_4c645e0a.info:
Change the internals of your AA-12 to make it able to fire in semi automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less rpm. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

20rd_drum_9967fdcd.name: 20rd Drum
20rd_drum_9967fdcd.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 20 rounds. Slightly reduces spare rounds carried, slightly slower reload speed.

ksg_25_extension_bc91cdb7.name: KSG 25 Extension
ksg_25_extension_bc91cdb7.info:
Lengthened barrel and tube(s) specially designed to make the KSG 25.
Works like a mix of extended tube and the longer barrel.
May impede speed, including aim, reload, and movement...

lengthened_barrel_750dc54d.name: Lengthened Barrel
lengthened_barrel_750dc54d.info:
Extended barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better range and bullet speed, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun. Worse movement.

shortened_barrel_dcaef0ba.name: Shortened Barrel
shortened_barrel_dcaef0ba.info:
A short, cut down barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better aim speed and hipfire control, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun.

s_12_50_conversion_91863577.name: S-12 50 Conversion
s_12_50_conversion_91863577.info:
Load your Saiga-12 with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- wait why are you doing this? Like, I get you changed the barrel and everything but... Either way, eat your heart out, AK Guy!

ithaca_trench_barrel_19a37aa2.name: ITHACA Trench Barrel
ithaca_trench_barrel_19a37aa2.info:
An old trench barrel for your M37.
Increases spread but allows you to slamfire faster than usual! (Press T)
Provided you don't use this to grate cheese, this makes sweeping the trenches all the easier!

ithaca_extended_tube_ddff49d2.name: ITHACA Extended Tube
ithaca_extended_tube_ddff49d2.info:
A longer tube for your M37 that holds more shells!
Can hold up to 7 shells at the cost of lower walk speed and slower handling! Also holds less shells in reserve!

m14_6_5_eca6c353.name: M14 6.5
m14_6_5_eca6c353.info:
Loads your M14 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
This cartridge offers your M14 more assault rifle characteristics such as lower damage, alongside a 30 round magazine. Slight improvements to penetration, velocity and recoil.

scar_h_10rd_811c6f92.name: SCAR-H 10rd
scar_h_10rd_811c6f92.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the MK17 SOCOM, ammo conservation will be harder in exchange for better reload time and some weight improvements.

scar_h_10rd_3773778a.name: SCAR-H 10rd
scar_h_10rd_3773778a.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the MK17 SOCOM, ammo conservation will be harder in exchange for better reload time and some weight improvements.

scar_h_7_62_conversion_7e710763.name: SCAR-H 7.62 Conversion
scar_h_7_62_conversion_7e710763.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MK17 SOCOM into 6.5 Creedmoor.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

scar_h_7_62_conversion_57d2544a.name: SCAR-H 7.62 Conversion
scar_h_7_62_conversion_57d2544a.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MK17 SOCOM into 6.5 Creedmoor.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

henry_big_boy_conversion_b4167db6.name: Henry Big Boy Conversion
henry_big_boy_conversion_b4167db6.info:
Load your Henry 45-70 with .357 Magnum, making it the Henry Big Boy.
Bring back nostalgia of an era you were not even born in.

henry_30_30_conversion_13837b76.name: Henry 30-30 Conversion
henry_30_30_conversion_13837b76.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 30-30, firing .30-30 Winchester.
Holds an extra round of ammunition with more accuracy, but less performance in some areas. Faster action.

henry_410_conversion_fb2c2206.name: Henry 410 Conversion
henry_410_conversion_fb2c2206.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 410, firing .410 bore.
Immense power in close range and good accuracy, but faulters strongly at range.

shak_12_heavy_suppressor_e30ccb34.name: SHAK-12 Heavy Suppressor
shak_12_heavy_suppressor_e30ccb34.info: A heavyweight suppressor for the ShAK-12 which provides excellent masking & sound suppression as well as improved recoil at the cost of handling.

shak_12_light_suppressor_7ecff0ca.name: SHAK-12 Light Suppressor
shak_12_light_suppressor_7ecff0ca.info: A lightweight suppressor designed for the ShAK-12. Reduces sound signature and slightly reduces gun performance. Poor masking range.

shak_12_7x55mm_lp_fe74fa96.name: SHAK 12.7x55mm LP
shak_12_7x55mm_lp_fe74fa96.info: Swaps your ammunition to 12.7x55mm LP supersonic ammo: a lightweight bullet that increases your muzzle velocity significantly while reducing damage. Comes with a 20-round extended magazine for more traditional battle rifle performance.

shak_12_7x55mm_dp_9cbaf494.name: SHAK 12.7x55mm DP
shak_12_7x55mm_dp_9cbaf494.info: Swaps your ammunition load to a duplex bullet! Fires two smaller, weaker projectiles that hit hard up close, but lose out on damage and accuracy at range.

shak_12_7x55mm_bp_7e463db5.name: SHAK 12.7x55mm BP
shak_12_7x55mm_bp_7e463db5.info: Load your ShAK-12 with 12.7x55mm BP armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration and performance to the torso, but reduced performance to the head.

g3_45_acp_conversion_0a62d81b.name: G3 .45 ACP Conversion
g3_45_acp_conversion_0a62d81b.info:
Convert your STG-59H into .45 Super.
Changing the weapon to feed from Thompson magazines this conversion can also function with the CETME Model 58 due to it and the STG-59H's similarities. Feels like using a full size battle rifle, but in a PDW-type package.

slx_suppressor_f83b34ee.name: SLX Suppressor
slx_suppressor_f83b34ee.info:
20 stud detection radius.

The new standard military suppressor for the M7!
Slightly increases damage ranges, bullet speed and lowers muzzle flip at the cost of a bit more vertical camera recoil and slightly slower handling!

mcx_spear_7_62x51_be29088b.name: MCX Spear 7.62x51
mcx_spear_7_62x51_be29088b.info: Converts the MCX SPEAR into firing traditional 7.62x51mm NATO. Increases overall damage to perform like a true battle rifle but lowers fire rate, bullet speed and penetration due to the slower bullet!

mcx_spear_6_5_creedmoor_313e7266.name: MCX Spear 6.5 Creedmoor
mcx_spear_6_5_creedmoor_313e7266.info: Converts your weapon to fire 6.5mm Creedmoor. Uses a 25rd magazine and improves recoil but lowers overall damage and penetration performance!

ak_308_gen_4_stock_d5477b4c.name: AK-308 Gen 4 Stock
ak_308_gen_4_stock_d5477b4c.info:
Gen 4 Stock Aesthetic.

Improved recoil management, but slightly increase aim and sprint transition times.

boombox_semi_group_09b39513.name: BOOMBOX Semi Group
boombox_semi_group_09b39513.info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your Doombox to be semi-automatic only!
Raises headshot & torso damage but reduces fire rate allowing you to play it like a subsonic DMR!

q_pork_chop_91f0da97.name: Q Pork Chop
q_pork_chop_91f0da97.info:
0 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor designed for large .30-cal magnum calibers. Deadly quiet. Improves damage ranges. Do not eat.

boombox_sd_suppressor_298e95c0.name: BOOMBOX SD Suppressor
boombox_sd_suppressor_298e95c0.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Uses a cut-off handguard with an integral suppressor.
Excellent radar & sound masking while mildly lowering weapon sway and recoil but slightly reduces handling speeds.
No effects on bullet speed, mobility or damage ranges!

hcar_open_bolt_fc3a562b.name: HCAR Open bolt
hcar_open_bolt_fc3a562b.info: Converts your HCAR to be fully automatic but gives up the ability to shoot semi-automatic.

rm277_8_6blk_conversion_a6765a7d.name: RM277 8.6BLK Conversion
rm277_8_6blk_conversion_a6765a7d.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire the subsonic 8.6mm Blackout cartridge!
This quieter cartridge fully hides you from the radar while increasing your ranged damage!
Very low bullet speed with weaker damage up close while also reducing penetration and firerate somewhat.

rm277_7_62x51_conversion_28503011.name: RM277 7.62x51 Conversion
rm277_7_62x51_conversion_28503011.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire 7.62x51mm NATO, a more traditional cartridge with a more traditional damage profile.

High damage with a simplified damage profile but decreases fire rate and muzzle velocity and increases recoil.

ecr_410_1fa134ce.name: ECR 410
ecr_410_1fa134ce.info: Convert your ECR to fire .410 bore, housing a 15 round magazine and strong firepower. Doesn't do well at range and struggles with maneuverability.

ecr_458_conversion_6adf2bb3.name: ECR .458 Conversion
ecr_458_conversion_6adf2bb3.info:
Loads your ECR with .458 SOCOM.
Lower damage, but significantly improved recoil and magazine capacity.

ecr_5_56_conversion_891960b2.name: ECR 5.56 Conversion
ecr_5_56_conversion_891960b2.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Expect unforeseen consequences...

scar_h_6_8_spc_conversion_c77e0e8a.name: SCAR-H 6.8 SPC Conversion
scar_h_6_8_spc_conversion_c77e0e8a.info:
Converts your MK17 SOCOM to fire 6.8x43mm SPC using a MK16 lower receiver!
It was experimented by the Grand Federation back around 2011 with limited examples.
Offers above-average assault rifle performance with a standard 30rd magazine capacity and similar fire rate to the MK16 SOCOM!

valorise_irons_d44d739a.name: Valorise Irons
valorise_irons_d44d739a.info: Iron sights from the FAMAS Valorise configuration.

valorise_irons_000b24f3.name: Valorise Irons
valorise_irons_000b24f3.info: Iron sights from the FAMAS Valorise configuration.

long_barrel_c7_d54278e0.name: Long Barrel (C7)
long_barrel_c7_d54278e0.info:
Extended barrel and large hanguard found on the DIEMACO LSW.
Worse mobility with greater recoil control and greatly extended ranges. Slower firerate.

long_barrel_c7_9a607208.name: Long Barrel (C7)
long_barrel_c7_9a607208.info:
An experimental heavy barrel and bipod for the XM16E1, allowing for excellent sustained fire & recoil control. Never adopted at scale.

Reduces rate of fire while dramatically improving recoil and damage multipliers.

aug_9mm_conversion_29e8030c.name: AUG 9MM Conversion
aug_9mm_conversion_29e8030c.info:
Converts your UAR A1 into the F88T training rifle using .22 LR!
Low damage to non-headshots while significantly lowering recoil, reload time and quicker handling.

aug_9mm_conversion_1690cb17.name: AUG 9MM Conversion
aug_9mm_conversion_1690cb17.info:
Converts your UAR A1 into the F88T training rifle using .22 LR!
Low damage to non-headshots while significantly lowering recoil, reload time and quicker handling.

ak12_gen_3_stock_191414f2.name: AK12 Gen 3 Stock
ak12_gen_3_stock_191414f2.info:
Equip the third generation (2016) AK-12 furniture setup.

Older stock design that enabled slightly faster shouldering while having a slightly worse cheek weld for camera recoil management.

ak_12m_45rd_26cb4c58.name: AK-12M 45rd
ak_12m_45rd_26cb4c58.info: Loads your AK-12M with a 45rd magazine, increasing magazine capacity at the cost of handling and mobility! Slightly reduced overall ammo storage, but the extra weight reduces some recoil.

gen_3_rear_sight_24733b6f.name: Gen 3 Rear Sight
gen_3_rear_sight_24733b6f.info: Equip the third generation (2016) AK-12 rear iron sight.

m16_burst_trigger_group_24ae399a.name: M16 Burst Trigger Group
m16_burst_trigger_group_24ae399a.info: Change the trigger group of your M16A3 to fire in 3-round burst and semi-automatic, making it an M16A2. Improves weapon damage and performance at long range.

ctar_barrel_7261cafe.name: CTAR Barrel
ctar_barrel_7261cafe.info:
Shortened barrel for the TAR-21, this barrel makes your TAR-21 into the CTAR-21.

This barrel reduces your long range potential that is typical to the TAR-21 to favour close quarters performance.

tar_duplex_ammo_e36ef784.name: TAR Duplex Ammo
tar_duplex_ammo_e36ef784.info: Specialty Colt 5.56x45 ammo stuffed with 2 bullets stacked on eachother. Splits the stats, and uses a smaller magazine than normal. More powerful than you'd expect, and reloads swiftly.

ak109_bars_barrel_ef5c0aff.name: AK109 BARS Barrel
ak109_bars_barrel_ef5c0aff.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats.

103_5_56_conversion_dc833e65.name: 103 5.56 Conversion
103_5_56_conversion_dc833e65.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AK-103 into 6.5mm Grendel.

Improves recoil, velocity, and penetration characteristics but has somewhat worse body damage.

k2_7_62x39_conversion_8f434b2c.name: K2 7.62x39 Conversion
k2_7_62x39_conversion_8f434b2c.info:
Loads your K2 with 7.62x39mm.
This turns your K2 into the rare civillian DR-300. This civilian rifle never really took off during its time, with faults being due to the cartridge it fires.

ak_19_6_02mm_mag_0e3055fc.name: AK-19 6.02mm Mag
ak_19_6_02mm_mag_0e3055fc.info:
Converts your AK-19 to fire 6.02x41mm - a highly experimental round designed in response to the Grand Federation NGSW program and 6.8x51mm ammo.
Intended as a universal replacement for 5.45x39 and 7.62x39, the AK-22 represents a hypothetical universal AK rifle. Very little else is known about the program, and it was likely shelved due to logistical costs.
Improves damage performance and penetration at the cost of recoil control.

aek_556_conversion_032a4306.name: AEK 556 Conversion
aek_556_conversion_032a4306.info:
Converts your AEK-971 to fire 5.56x45mm turning it into the AEK-972!
Improved range damage while slightly lowering accuracy and damage up close.

regular_mag_type_88_0d66a368.name: Regular Mag (Type 88)
regular_mag_type_88_0d66a368.info: Equip the more commonly used 30-round magazine to your Type 88. Less obstructive and more ergonomic for your firearm. Better speed in general, Easier to control recoil.

7_62_conversion_type_88_addc14a1.name: 7.62 Conversion (Type 88)
7_62_conversion_type_88_addc14a1.info: Retool your TYPE 88 into the TYPE 58, a 7.62x39mm rifle adopted by Hwanmok in 1958 using a 30 round magazine. A lot more power thanks to the new cartridge, however a lot less recoil control.

vhs_d2_ct_1_5x_c3849919.name: VHS-D2 CT 1.5x
vhs_d2_ct_1_5x_c3849919.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The VHS-D2 CT 1.5x is an integrated telescopic scope for the VHS-D2.

an_7_62x39_conversion_db710176.name: AN 7.62x39 Conversion
an_7_62x39_conversion_db710176.info: Changes the ammotype fired to 7.62x39mm. Based on the prototyping / dummy model of the AN94 that theoretically fired 7.62x39mm. Expect AK-like traits such more power and recoil.

max_11_15_sd_barrel_7a444c93.name: MAX-11/15 SD Barrel
max_11_15_sd_barrel_7a444c93.info:
20 stud detection radius.

An integrally suppressed barrel based off the CAR-15SD!
Improves close range, hipfire spread and aim walkspeed but reduced ranged performance and bullet speed due to a shorter barrel!

aug_a2_7_62x39_conversion_c24dbb64.name: AUG A2 7.62x39 Conversion
aug_a2_7_62x39_conversion_c24dbb64.info:
Loads your F90 MBR with .224 Valkyrie.
Uses special 25rd magazines made for the Valkyrie cartridge.
Significantly increases ranged bullet performance both in damage and velocity but less powerful towards limb damage up close and increases recoil.

hk337_300_conversion_4cfdc001.name: HK337 .300 Conversion
hk337_300_conversion_4cfdc001.info:
Converts your M416 to fire 6.8x43mm SPC!The 6.8mm Special Purpose Cartridge is an intermediate rifle cartridge developed to possibly replace 5.56x45mm.
While it offered superior lethality up close with minimal loss of magazine capacity and negligible increase in recoil, it began to falter at longer ranges and was dropped due to logistical and cost issues.

g36_300_conversion_7e2260b7.name: G36 .300 Conversion
g36_300_conversion_7e2260b7.info:
Load your STG-91 with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group. It offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

m16a2_buffer_stock_0bcddf62.name: M16A2 Buffer Stock
m16a2_buffer_stock_0bcddf62.info: Uses the buffer tube from a traditional M16A2 to significantly increase your fire rate, destabilizes your recoil and reduces damage performance!

colt_acr_m855_7bd0cea1.name: COLT ACR M855
colt_acr_m855_7bd0cea1.info:
Uses M855 instead of Duplex rounds. More accurate than the base ammo!
Deals good damage to the torso and head, high bullet speed, good penetration and lower recoil but fires slow and not so good at dealing limb damage!

colt_acr_phase_1_duplex_23518ad3.name: COLT ACR Phase-1 Duplex
colt_acr_phase_1_duplex_23518ad3.info:
Uses experimental Phase-1 Duplex rounds, it's made of a tungsten core which has more penetration than your base ammo, but at the cost of limb and headshot damage, and your bullet speed!
Comes with a 20rd magazine improving your reload, walk and handling speed!

ak15_gen_4_stock_d97713fb.name: AK15 Gen 4 Stock
ak15_gen_4_stock_d97713fb.info:
Gen 4 Stock Aesthetic.

Improved recoil management, but slightly increase aim and sprint transition times.

scar_l_9mm_conversion_5ef870b7.name: SCAR L 9mm Conversion
scar_l_9mm_conversion_5ef870b7.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM to fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit.
Uses a 50rd drum magazine. Focusses on CQC by increasing the fire rate, close range damage and reducing the recoil but at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and penetration!

556_stg_575c144b.name: 556 STG
556_stg_575c144b.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your STG into 5.56x45mm NATO making it the ''STG-N'' with a 60 round casket magazine.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
You have defiled history.

m231_wire_stock_ad6b290e.name: M231 Wire Stock
m231_wire_stock_ad6b290e.info: Aftermarket wire stock fitted onto your illegal firearm. Do you really expect this to help..?

m855_specialty_conversion_72ecf11a.name: M855 Specialty Conversion
m855_specialty_conversion_72ecf11a.info:
Load your M231 with M855 5.56x45mm NATO.
 housed in a modified 100-round Beta-C double drum. They tumble quickly after leaving the barrel, causing inaccuracies when firing. An aura of sadness surrounds this conversion. It's as if a fallen hero once wielded this weapon...

ak12_bars_barrel_cfa1aa61.name: AK12 BARS Barrel
ak12_bars_barrel_cfa1aa61.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats. Three-round burst-fire becomes the main firing option, accuracy greatly improved with the BARS system.

carry_handle_grip_dbac5d94.name: Carry Handle Grip
carry_handle_grip_dbac5d94.info: A peculiar mounting of the M16's carry handle, often done to prevent it from getting lost. I guess it works as a grip though?

integrated_bren3_b28d344d.name: Integrated BREN3
integrated_bren3_b28d344d.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the VZ.808 rifle. Increases close-range damage while reducing damage at range.
25 studs detection range.

bren_300_conversion_23d0b46c.name: BREN .300 Conversion
bren_300_conversion_23d0b46c.info:
Loads your VZ.808 with supersonic .300 AAC Blackout!
Improves close range damage and penetration for reduced damage ranges, muzzle velocity and slightly increased recoil!
Great with suppressors!

bren_2_7_62x39mm_199a2b4a.name: Bren 2 7.62x39mm
bren_2_7_62x39mm_199a2b4a.info:
Converts your VZ.806 to fire 7.62x39mm!
Overall large increase in damage, penetration and suppression but at the cost of your fire rate, bullet speed and recoil!

integral_t20_f420ac3c.name: Integral T20
integral_t20_f420ac3c.info:
An integral suppressor for the Type 20.
Improves close quarters performance while trading off damage in range. Low suppression radius and volume.

60rd_t20_2bb904d8.name: 60rd T20
60rd_t20_2bb904d8.info: Shove a 60 round drum magazine into your TYPE 20 to help mow down your foes. Drastically affects your weapon handling.

20_round_type_20_f051d9d6.name: 20 Round Type 20
20_round_type_20_f051d9d6.info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

over_charge_m41a_53df5d4d.name: Over Charge (M41A)
over_charge_m41a_53df5d4d.info: Load your pulse rifle with overcharged ammo!

u1_31x71mm_grenades_fce8770e.name: U1 31x71mm Grenades
u1_31x71mm_grenades_fce8770e.info:
So you ever notice that underbarrel grenade launcher you have? Well don't question it now, I am letting you use it.

just ignore how buggy the first shell insert is, ok?

akm_366_slugs_9e0c7f88.name: AKM .366 (Slugs)
akm_366_slugs_9e0c7f88.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM ammunition.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are soft point rounds.

akm_366_buckshot_9e20000f.name: AKM .366 (Buckshot)
akm_366_buckshot_9e20000f.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

banana_5de897fe.name: Banana
banana_5de897fe.info: There's always bullets in the banana mag.

five_seven_full_auto_3f8b964b.name: Five-Seven Full Auto
five_seven_full_auto_3f8b964b.info: An aftermarket modification turning the gun into a full-auto machine gun - at the cost of rapidly dumping the contents of the magazine after pulling the trigger.

glock_switch_0b833b90.name: Glock Switch
glock_switch_0b833b90.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

glock_switch_6b5da750.name: Glock Switch
glock_switch_6b5da750.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

glock_switch_fcc9b0d1.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

glock_switch_f2a78823.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

integral_u416_216ed5a4.name: Integral U416
integral_u416_216ed5a4.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the U-527/22.

Improves performance at close range at the cost of ranged performance and velocity. Excellent masking.

u416_binary_8c0c785d.name: U416 Binary
u416_binary_8c0c785d.info:
Modify your U-527/22 to fit it with a binary trigger group.
A binary trigger fires one round when you hold down the trigger, but also fires again when you let go!
Increases fire rate but reduces headshot damage.

shoulder_stock_d176fa4e.name: Shoulder Stock
shoulder_stock_d176fa4e.info:
A pistol stock that helps to brace against recoil and maintain a more stable firing position.

Reduces muzzle flip and gun sway significantly, but overall worse handling.

shoulder_stock_4c24070e.name: Shoulder Stock
shoulder_stock_4c24070e.info:
A pistol stock that helps to brace against recoil and maintain a more stable firing position.

Reduces muzzle flip and gun sway significantly, but overall worse handling.

target_weight_a21a9520.name: Target Weight
target_weight_a21a9520.info: Attach a weight to the front of the GSP's barrel to counter against the rising recoil for better accuracy, but at the cost of general maneuverability.

gsp_32_s_w_fa973d6e.name: GSP 32 S&W
gsp_32_s_w_fa973d6e.info: Convert your GSP into the GSP-C, firing the .32 S&W Long round. It is perfect for those who can't seem to land headshots.

gsp_rat_shot_65863c56.name: GSP Rat Shot
gsp_rat_shot_65863c56.info: Aiming? You don't need to do that. Just spitball tiny, almost harmless pellets at people until they ask you to stop. It cannot even properly cycle rounds, forcing you to manually cycle the bullets each shot.

10_round_gsh_18_8d98b6df.name: 10 Round GSH-18
10_round_gsh_18_8d98b6df.info: Swap your magazine for a reduced 10 round capacity magazine! Improves reload speed and handling!

45_rubber_gsh_18_d15ab712.name: .45 RUBBER GSH-18
45_rubber_gsh_18_d15ab712.info:
Loads your GSH-18 with .45 Rubber!
Increased damage overall and will always one shot to the head, but extremely poor penetrating power, suppression and velocity!
Requires manual rechambering!

gb_50_ae_conversion_526a6800.name: GB .50 AE Conversion
gb_50_ae_conversion_526a6800.info:
Load your GB-22 with .50 AE.
 This makes it a GB-50. The larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried.

gb_12g_conversion_dcb2c283.name: GB 12G Conversion
gb_12g_conversion_dcb2c283.info:
Somehow load your GB-22 with 12 gauge minishells.
 This makes it a GB-12.
More pellets for greater damage, but horrid muzzle velcoity and less ammunition carried.

gb_10mm_conversion_eff64a3e.name: GB 10mm Conversion
gb_10mm_conversion_eff64a3e.info:
Load your GB-22 with 10mm Auto.
 This makes it a GB-10, the larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried. Great velocity.

30rd_mag_g40_20931420.name: 30rd Mag G40
30rd_mag_g40_20931420.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G40. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

glock_stock_9da715bf.name: Glock Stock
